static Value popScalarToBuiltinType(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, Value v) {
  auto type = cast<KGEN::SIMDType>(v.getType());
  auto maybeDtype = type.getResolvedDType();
  assert(maybeDtype && "unable to resolve dtype");

  auto dtype = *maybeDtype;

  MLIRContext *ctx = builder.getContext();

  auto resultType =
      dtype.isIndex()
          ? (Type)IndexType::get(ctx)
          : (Type)M::getEquivalentIntegerType(ctx, DType(dtype.getValue()));

  return builder.createOrFold<KGEN::POP::CastToBuiltinOp>(loc, resultType, v);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MOGraphLoweringState
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

ErrorOr<ElementsAttr>
MOGraphLoweringState::lowerElementsAttr(ElementsAttr elementsAttr) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = getExecuteOpBuilder().getContext();

  uint64_t alignment = static_cast<uint64_t>(getMinimumCpuAlignment());

  auto hasAlignedAttr = dyn_cast<HasAlignedBytesInterface>(elementsAttr);
  if (hasAlignedAttr == nullptr)
    return Error("unsupported constant attribute type");
  auto origType = hasAlignedAttr.getAlignedBytesType();

  alignment = std::max(alignment, origType.getAlign());

  auto finalType = AlignedBytesType::get(ctx, origType.getSize(), alignment);

  if (auto arrayAttr = dyn_cast<ArrayElementsAttr>(elementsAttr)) {
    // Reuse the data as is; the aligned_bytes type conveys the MEF alignment.
    static constexpr size_t kLargeDataThreshold = 512;
    if (arrayAttr.getRawData().size() < kLargeDataThreshold) {
      return AlignedBytesAttr::get(ctx, arrayAttr.getRawData(), alignment);
    } else {
      std::string name = "const_" + std::to_string(getExecuteNextConstId());
      ArrayRef<char> data(
          reinterpret_cast<const char *>(arrayAttr.getRawData().data()),
          arrayAttr.getRawData().size());
      return DenseResourceElementsAttr::get(
          finalType,
          DenseResourceElementsHandle::getManagerInterface(ctx).insert(
              name, mlir::UnmanagedAsmResourceBlob::allocateWithAlign(
                        data, alignment)));
    }
  }

  if (auto resourceAttr = dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(elementsAttr)) {
    // Reuse the blob; the type carries the alignment.
    return DenseResourceElementsAttr::get(finalType,
                                          resourceAttr.getRawHandle());
  }

  if (auto alignedAttr = dyn_cast<AlignedBytesAttr>(elementsAttr))
    return AlignedBytesAttr::get(ctx, alignedAttr.getData(), alignment);

  llvm_unreachable(
      "missing case for implementation of HasAlignedBytesInterface");
}

TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>
MOGraphLoweringState::getShape(Location loc, Value loweredTensor,
                               DeviceRefAttr device) {
  OpBuilder &builder = getExecuteOpBuilder();
  return getBufferBuilder(device).tensorExtractTensorSpec(builder, loc,
                                                          loweredTensor);
}

MGP::TensorSpecGetDimOp MOGraphLoweringState::getDim(Location loc,
                                                     Value loweredTensor,
                                                     uint64_t axis,
                                                     DeviceRefAttr device) {
  OpBuilder &builder = getExecuteOpBuilder();
  // Not getShape: callers usually also need the buffer, i.e. a full
  // tensor.extract anyway.
  TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType> tensorSpec =
      getBufferBuilder(device).tensorExtractTensorSpec(builder, loc,
                                                       loweredTensor);
  return MGP::TensorSpecGetDimOp::create(builder, loc, /*spec=*/tensorSpec,
                                         /*axis=*/axis);
}

SmallVector<Value> MOGraphLoweringState::getDynamicDims(Location loc,
                                                        Value loweredTensor,
                                                        DeviceRefAttr device) {
  OpBuilder &builder = getExecuteOpBuilder();
  // Not getShape: callers usually also need the buffer, i.e. a full
  // tensor.extract anyway.
  TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType> tensorSpec =
      getBufferBuilder(device).tensorExtractTensorSpec(builder, loc,
                                                       loweredTensor);
  TensorSpecType specType = tensorSpec.getType();
  SmallVector<Value> dynDims;

  for (size_t i = 0; i < specType.getRank(); ++i)
    if (specType.isDynamicDim(i))
      dynDims.push_back(
          MGP::TensorSpecGetDimOp::create(builder, loc, tensorSpec, i));

  return dynDims;
}

static Value assertSymbolicDimensionMatchesPreviousValue(
    OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, Value previousValue, Value newValue,
    KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr symbolicDimension, unsigned argumentIndex) {

  FailureOr<Type> targetType = previousValue.getType();
  // TODO: cast?
  Value isEqual = KGEN::POP::CmpOp::create(builder, loc, KGEN::CmpPredicate::EQ,
                                           previousValue, newValue);

  isEqual = popScalarToBuiltinType(builder, loc, isEqual);

  auto errorMessage = llvm::formatv(
      "symbolic dimension '{}' for input {} does not match prior uses "
      "of that dimension",
      symbolicDimension.getName().strref(), argumentIndex);

  return MGP::AssertOp::create(builder, loc, isEqual,
                               builder.getStringAttr(errorMessage));
}

ErrorOr<MOGraphLoweringState::ArgLoweringResult>
MOGraphLoweringState::lowerArg(Region *parentRegion, BlockArgument inArg,
                               BlockArgument outArg) {
  bool hasParams = false;
  Location loc = inArg.getLoc();

  auto isSubgraphRegion = [](Region *region) {
    if (auto graph = region->getParentOfType<MO::GraphOp>())
      return graph.getIsSubgraph();
    return false;
  };

  Value loweredArg = outArg;
  if (auto argType = MO::dynCastFromTensorLike(inArg.getType())) {
    DeviceRefAttr argDevice = MO::getDeviceOrDefault(argType);
    if (argType.hasStaticShape()) {
      // No parameters to deal with.
    } else if (auto inShapeParam =
                   dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(argType.getShape())) {
      // A whole-shape parameter maps to the runtime MGP shape (a tensor_spec
      // of unknown dtype), on its first occurrence only.
      hasParams = true;
      if (!params.lookupLowered(parentRegion, inShapeParam))
        params.emplaceLowered(parentRegion, inShapeParam,
                              getShape(loc, outArg, argDevice));
    } else {
      // Map each dim parameter to its runtime dimension on first occurrence.
      // Dims are extracted as a group regardless; DCE cleans up if all were
      // already mapped.
      hasParams = true;

      SmallVector<Value> dynDims = getDynamicDims(loc, outArg, argDevice);
      // Arbitrary expressions in the MO shape signature are unsupported.
      SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr> inDimParams;
      for (TypedAttr inDim : argType.getDims()) {
        if (auto inDimParam = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(inDim))
          inDimParams.emplace_back(inDimParam);
      }
      if (dynDims.size() != inDimParams.size()) {
        // TODO(#14531) handle param expr
        return Error("Expressions in parameter arguments are not supported");
      }

      OpBuilder &builder = getExecuteOpBuilder();
      SmallVector<Value> assertChains;
      for (auto [inDimParam, outDim] : llvm::zip_equal(inDimParams, dynDims)) {
        auto existingValue = params.lookupLowered(parentRegion, inDimParam);
        auto loweredValue = indexToDimension(builder, loc, outDim);

        if (existingValue && !isSubgraphRegion(parentRegion)) {
          // Subgraphs inherit this check from their caller.
          auto assert = assertSymbolicDimensionMatchesPreviousValue(
              builder, loc, existingValue, loweredValue, inDimParam,
              inArg.getArgNumber());

          assertChains.push_back(assert);
        } else {
          params.emplaceLowered(parentRegion, inDimParam, loweredValue);
        }
      }

      if (!assertChains.empty()) {
        auto consolidatedChains =
            GRT::ChainCreateOp::create(builder, loc, assertChains);

        auto guarded =
            MGP::GuardOp::create(builder, loc, consolidatedChains, outArg);

        loweredArg = guarded.getResult(0);
      }
    }
  }
  return ArgLoweringResult{hasParams, loweredArg};
}

ErrorOr<Value> MOGraphLoweringState::lowerExpression(Region *parentRegion,
                                                     Location loc,
                                                     TypedAttr attr) {
  auto newValOr = params.lowerExpression(
      getExecuteOpBuilder(), loc, parentRegion, attr,
      [this](auto &&...args) { return this->lowerExpressionImpl(args...); });

  if (newValOr.isError())
    return newValOr.takeError();
  auto newVal = std::move(*newValOr);

  // Remember placeholders in case an SSA value maps to one later.
  if (auto placeholder = newVal.getDefiningOp<ParamPlaceholderOp>())
    placeholderMap.try_emplace(placeholder, SmallVector<Value>{});
  return newVal;
}

ErrorOrSuccess MOGraphLoweringState::lowerParamDecl(
    Region *parentRegion, KGEN::ParamDeclAttr declAttr, Value value) {
  Value maybePlaceholder = params.lowerParamDecl(parentRegion, declAttr, value);

  if (maybePlaceholder) {
    // A resolved placeholder must never be mapped to again.
    if (auto it = placeholderMap.find(maybePlaceholder);
        it != placeholderMap.end()) {
      for (Value key : it->second) {
        execute.loweredValues.erase(key);
        execute.loweredValues.try_emplace(key, value);
      }
      placeholderMap.erase(it);
    }

    maybePlaceholder.replaceAllUsesWith(value);
    maybePlaceholder.getDefiningOp<ParamPlaceholderOp>().erase();
  }
  return success();
}

ErrorOr<SmallVector<Value>> MOGraphLoweringState::lowerShapeAttrDynDims(
    Region *parentRegion, MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr, Location loc) {
  SmallVector<Value> runtimeDims;
  for (TypedAttr dim : shapeAttr.getValues()) {
    if (!MOSH::ShapeAttr::getStaticDim(dim).has_value()) {
      auto vOr = lowerDimensionExpression(params, getExecuteOpBuilder(), loc,
                                          parentRegion, dim);
      if (vOr.isError())
        return vOr.takeError();
      runtimeDims.emplace_back(vOr.takeValue());
    }
  }
  return runtimeDims;
}

/// Reduces `values` with binary ops, lowering variadic KGEN::POC ops.
template <typename Op>
static ErrorOr<Value> buildVariadicOp(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                      ValueRange operands, Type resultType) {
  if (operands.empty())
    return Error("Variadic op without operands");

  Value start = operands.front();
  ValueRange rest = operands.drop_front();

  auto createBinop = [&](Value lhs, Value rhs) {
    return Op::create(builder, loc, resultType, lhs, rhs);
  };

  return std::accumulate(rest.begin(), rest.end(), start, createBinop);
}

/// Convert a KGEN::POC operation on !kgen.scalar values to the POP dialect.
static ErrorOr<Value> pocToMopInteger(KGEN::POC poc, OpBuilder &builder,
                                      Location loc, ValueRange operands,
                                      Type resultType) {
  auto getCmpPredicate = [](KGEN::POC poc) -> KGEN::CmpPredicate {
    switch (poc) {
    case KGEN::POC::EQ:
      return KGEN::CmpPredicate::EQ;
    case KGEN::POC::LT:
      return KGEN::CmpPredicate::LT;
    case KGEN::POC::LE:
      return KGEN::CmpPredicate::LE;
    default:
      llvm_unreachable("unrecognized predicate");
    }
  };

  switch (poc) {
  // All comparisons lower to `pop.cmp`
  case KGEN::POC::EQ:
  case KGEN::POC::LT:
  case KGEN::POC::LE:
    return KGEN::POP::CmpOp::create(builder, loc, resultType,
                                    getCmpPredicate(poc), operands[0],
                                    operands[1]);

  // All potentially variadic ops
  case KGEN::POC::Add:
    return buildVariadicOp<KGEN::POP::AddOp>(builder, loc, operands,
                                             resultType);
  case KGEN::POC::Div:
    return buildVariadicOp<KGEN::POP::DivOp>(builder, loc, operands,
                                             resultType);
  case KGEN::POC::Max:
    return buildVariadicOp<KGEN::POP::MaxOp>(builder, loc, operands,
                                             resultType);
  case KGEN::POC::Min:
    return buildVariadicOp<KGEN::POP::MinOp>(builder, loc, operands,
                                             resultType);
  case KGEN::POC::Mul:
  case KGEN::POC::MulNoWrap:
    return buildVariadicOp<KGEN::POP::MulOp>(builder, loc, operands,
                                             resultType);
  case KGEN::POC::And:
    return buildVariadicOp<KGEN::POP::SIMDAndOp>(builder, loc, operands,
                                                 resultType);
  case KGEN::POC::Or:
    return buildVariadicOp<KGEN::POP::SIMDOrOp>(builder, loc, operands,
                                                resultType);
  case KGEN::POC::Xor:
    return buildVariadicOp<KGEN::POP::SIMDXOrOp>(builder, loc, operands,
                                                 resultType);

  // Remaining ops
  case KGEN::POC::Shl:
    return KGEN::POP::ShlOp::create(builder, loc, resultType, operands);
  case KGEN::POC::Shr:
    return KGEN::POP::ShrOp::create(builder, loc, resultType, operands);
  case KGEN::POC::Mod:
    return KGEN::POP::RemOp::create(builder, loc, resultType, operands);
  case KGEN::POC::Cond: {
    auto condition = operands[0];
    auto trueValue = operands[1];
    auto falseValue = operands[2];
    return KGEN::POP::SIMDSelectOp::create(builder, loc, resultType, condition,
                                           trueValue, falseValue);
  }
  default:
    return Error(Twine("unsupported POC '") + stringifyPOC(poc) + "'");
  }
}

ErrorOr<Value>
MOGraphLoweringState::lowerParamOperator(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                         KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr opAttr,
                                         ValueRange operands) {
  auto resultType = opAttr.getType();

  ASSERT_STREAM(isa<KGEN::SIMDType>(resultType),
                "must be a simd parameter expression");

  SmallVector<Value> popOperands;
  popOperands.reserve(operands.size());

  for (auto operand : operands) {
    ASSERT_STREAM(isa<KGEN::SIMDType>(operand.getType()),
                  "must be a simd parameter expression");
    popOperands.push_back(operand);
  }

  auto maybeResult = pocToMopInteger(opAttr.getOpcode(), builder, loc,
                                     popOperands, resultType);

  if (maybeResult.isError())
    return maybeResult;

  return maybeResult.takeValue();
}

Operation *MOGraphLoweringState::lowerKGENConstantAttr(OpBuilder &builder,
                                                       Location loc,
                                                       TypedAttr value) {
  return KGEN::ParamConstantOp::create(builder, loc, value);
}

/// Sequenced assert lowering helpers.
namespace {

bool followOperands(Operation *op) {
  // POP::And/Or/XOrOp rather than index::*, to handle more than IndexType.
  return isa<KGEN::POP::POPDialect>(op->getDialect());
}

DenseSet<Operation *> getAncestors(Operation *root) {

  DenseSet<Operation *> ancestors;
  SmallVector<Operation *> worklist;

  worklist.push_back(root);

  while (!worklist.empty()) {
    Operation *op = worklist.pop_back_val();

    if (!op || !followOperands(op))
      continue;

    ancestors.insert(op);

    for (Value val : op->getOperands()) {
      Operation *defOp = val.getDefiningOp();

      if (!ancestors.contains(defOp))
        worklist.push_back(defOp);
    }
  }

  return ancestors;
}

SmallVector<OpOperand *>
getBoundaryOpOperands(Operation *root,
                      const llvm::DenseSet<Operation *> &prevAncestors) {

  DenseSet<OpOperand *> boundaryOpOperands;
  SmallVector<Operation *> worklist;

  worklist.push_back(root);

  while (!worklist.empty()) {

    Operation *op = worklist.pop_back_val();

    if (!op || !followOperands(op) || prevAncestors.contains(op))
      continue;

    for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands()) {
      auto defOp = opOperand.get().getDefiningOp();
      if (!defOp)
        continue;

      const bool isTrivial = defOp->hasTrait<OpTrait::ConstantLike>() ||
                             isa<mlir::CastOpInterface>(defOp);

      if (prevAncestors.contains(defOp) && !isTrivial)
        boundaryOpOperands.insert(&opOperand);
      else
        worklist.push_back(defOp);
    }
  }

  return {boundaryOpOperands.begin(), boundaryOpOperands.end()};
}

/// Returns the OpOperands crossing from the previous assertion's condition tree
/// into the current assertion's.
SmallVector<OpOperand *> getSequencedAssertBoundaryOperands(
    Value cond, const SmallVector<Operation *> &parentAsserts) {

  DenseSet<Operation *> allAncestors;

  for (auto parentAssert : parentAsserts) {
    auto prevAssertCondRoot =
        cast<MGP::AssertOp>(parentAssert).getCond().getDefiningOp();

    auto prevAncestors = getAncestors(prevAssertCondRoot);

    allAncestors.insert(prevAncestors.begin(), prevAncestors.end());
  }

  return getBoundaryOpOperands(cond.getDefiningOp(), allAncestors);
}

SmallVector<Operation *>
getParentAsserts(Operation *currentAssert,
                 const DenseMap<Operation *, Operation *> &parentMap) {
  SmallVector<Operation *> parents = {currentAssert};

  auto it = parentMap.find(currentAssert);
  bool hasParent = it != parentMap.end();

  while (hasParent) {
    currentAssert = it->second;
    parents.push_back(currentAssert);
    it = parentMap.find(currentAssert);
    hasParent = it != parentMap.end();
  }

  return parents;
}

} // namespace

ErrorOr<Value> MOGraphLoweringState::lowerDimensionExpression(
    ParameterLoweringState &state, OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
    Region *parentRegion, TypedAttr dim) {
  auto dimValOr = state.lowerExpression(
      builder, loc, parentRegion, dim,
      [this](auto &&...args) { return this->lowerExpressionImpl(args...); });

  if (failed(dimValOr))
    return dimValOr;

  return dimensionToIndex(builder, loc, dimValOr.takeValue());
}

ErrorOr<Value> MOGraphLoweringState::lowerExpressionImpl(
    ParameterLoweringState &state, OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
    Region *parentRegion, TypedAttr attr, ValueRange operands) {
  Operation *newOp;
  if (isa<IntegerAttr, KGEN::SIMDAttr>(attr)) {
    newOp = lowerKGENConstantAttr(builder, loc, attr);
  } else if (auto cast = dyn_cast<KGEN::CastFromBuiltinAttr>(attr)) {
    ErrorOr<Value> castFrom = lowerExpression(parentRegion, loc, cast.getArg());
    if (failed(castFrom))
      return castFrom;
    newOp = KGEN::POP::CastFromBuiltinOp::create(builder, loc, cast.getType(),
                                                 castFrom.takeValue());
  } else if (auto opAttr = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr>(attr)) {
    return lowerParamOperator(builder, loc, opAttr, operands);
  } else if (auto identical = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamIdenticalAttr>(attr)) {
    // Scalar int-like `eq` canonicalizes to `identical`, which lowers the same
    // way: a compare of the two operands.
    ASSERT_STREAM(identical.getNumOperands() == 2,
                  "expected binary identity from scalar eq");
    return pocToMopInteger(KGEN::POC::EQ, builder, loc, operands,
                           identical.getType());
  } else if (auto opAttr = dyn_cast<KGEN::MLIROpAttr>(attr)) {
    StringAttr opName = opAttr.getName();
    if (opName != MO::AssertOp::getOperationName()) {
      return Error(Twine("cannot lower mlir operation '") + opName.strref() +
                   "' in parameter expression");
    }

    auto [cond, maybeParentAssert] = [&]() -> std::pair<Value, Operation *> {
      bool hasChain = isa<MEF::ChainType>(operands[0].getType());

      if (hasChain) {
        Value chain = operands[0];
        Value cond = operands[1];

        ASSERT_STREAM(
            isa<MGP::AssertOp>(chain.getDefiningOp()),
            << "Encountered a mo.assert with a chain that was not produced by "
               "another mo.assert!");

        SmallVector<Operation *> parentAsserts =
            getParentAsserts(chain.getDefiningOp(), execute.parentAssert);

        auto bOperands =
            getSequencedAssertBoundaryOperands(cond, parentAsserts);

        // Guard only shared values: mgp.guard has no Mojo implementation, so
        // it blocks sequence fusion.
        if (!bOperands.empty()) {
          SmallVector<Value> v;
          for (OpOperand *opOperand : bOperands) {
            v.push_back(opOperand->get());
          }

          ValueRange guardedValRange{v};

          auto guardOp = MGP::GuardOp::create(
              builder, loc, guardedValRange.getTypes(), chain, guardedValRange);

          for (auto &&[guarded, original] :
               llvm::zip(guardOp.getResults(), bOperands)) {
            original->assign(guarded);
          }
        }

        return {cond, chain.getDefiningOp()};
      } else {
        return {operands[0], nullptr};
      }
    }();

    if (cond.getType() != builder.getIntegerType(1)) {
      assert(KGEN::isScalarOf<KGEN::KGENDType::kBool>(cond.getType()));
      cond = builder.createOrFold<KGEN::POP::CastToBuiltinOp>(
          loc, builder.getIntegerType(1), cond);
    }
    // An assert. The dictionary comes from an arbitrary op, so split the
    // inherent `message` into properties by name.
    MGP::AssertOp::Properties properties;
    SmallVector<NamedAttribute> discardableAttributes;
    StringRef messageName = MGP::AssertOp::getAttributeNames().front();
    for (NamedAttribute namedAttr : opAttr.getAttrs()) {
      if (namedAttr.getName() == messageName)
        properties.setMessage(::M::cast<StringAttr>(namedAttr.getValue()));
      else
        discardableAttributes.push_back(namedAttr);
    }

    MGP::AssertOp assertOp = MGP::AssertOp::create(
        builder, loc, ValueRange{cond}, properties, discardableAttributes);

    newOp = assertOp;
    if (maybeParentAssert)
      execute.parentAssert[newOp] = maybeParentAssert;
  } else if (auto shapeAttr = dyn_cast<MOSH::ShapeAttr>(attr)) {
    SmallVector<Value> dimVals;
    for (TypedAttr dim : shapeAttr.getValues()) {
      auto dimValOr =
          lowerDimensionExpression(state, builder, loc, parentRegion, dim);

      if (dimValOr.isError())
        return dimValOr.takeError();
      dimVals.emplace_back(std::move(*dimValOr));
    }

    // MGP has no runtime shape type; use a fully dynamic spec.
    SmallVector<std::optional<uint64_t>> dummyShape(dimVals.size());
    auto specTy =
        MGP::TensorSpecType::get(loc.getContext(), dummyShape, DType::si64);
    auto specOp =
        MGP::TensorSpecCreateOp::create(builder, loc, specTy, dimVals);
    return specOp.getResult();
  } else {
    return Error("cannot lower parameter expression");
  }

  return newOp->getResult(0);
}

/// Returns `T` for `!mogg.async<T>`, else `type`.
static Type getAsyncElementOrSelf(Type type) {
  if (auto asyncType = dyn_cast<MOGG::AsyncType>(type))
    return asyncType.getElementType();
  return type;
}

/// Rewires consumers of `asyncValue` to its synchronous `projection`, except
/// the projection itself and `mogg.async.unpack` ops.
static void rewireAsyncConsumersToProjection(Value asyncValue,
                                             Value projection) {
  Operation *projectionOp = projection.getDefiningOp();
  asyncValue.replaceUsesWithIf(projection, [&](mlir::OpOperand &operand) {
    Operation *owner = operand.getOwner();
    return owner != projectionOp && !isa<MOGG::AsyncUnpackOp>(owner);
  });
}

void MOGraphLoweringState::lowerMOGGABI(MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp kernel) {
  auto builder = OpBuilder::atBlockBegin(&kernel.getBodyBlock());

  auto loc = kernel->getLoc();
  MOGG::OutputOp terminator = kernel.getBodyTerminator();

  // Chain inputs should never be used; replace them with a dummy chain.
  for (BlockArgument arg : kernel.getBodyBlock().getArguments()) {
    if (isa<MEF::ChainType>(getAsyncElementOrSelf(arg.getType()))) {
      arg.replaceAllUsesWith(
          MOGG::ChainDummyOp::create(builder, loc).getResult());
    }
  }

  // Unpack inputs before packing outputs, which inspects the unpacked body
  // operands.
  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(&kernel.getBody().front());
  for (auto v : kernel.getBody().getArguments()) {
    if (isa<MEF::ChainType>(getAsyncElementOrSelf(v.getType())))
      continue;

    auto unpackOp = MOGG::AsyncUnpackOp::create(builder, loc, v);
    rewireAsyncConsumersToProjection(v, unpackOp);
  }

  builder.setInsertionPoint(terminator);
  // Chain AsyncReadyOps go after all other packs so consumers wait for every
  // output.
  SmallVector<std::pair<size_t, Value>> deferredChainOps;

  for (auto [i, value] : llvm::enumerate(terminator->getOperands())) {
    if (isa<MEF::ChainType>(value.getType())) {
      deferredChainOps.emplace_back(i, value);
      continue;
    }

    // Non-chain outputs carry their own storage handle, so all take the owned
    // pack path.
    Value newValue = MOGG::AsyncPackOp::create(
        builder, loc, MOGG::AsyncType::get(value.getType()), value);

    value.replaceUsesWithIf(
        newValue, [&](OpOperand &use) { return use.getOwner() == terminator; });

    // Sink chains so a sole chain output isn't DCE-ed.
    if (isa<MEF::ChainType>(value.getType()) &&
        !isa<MOGG::AsyncReadyOp>(value.getDefiningOp()))
      MOGG::ChainSinkOp::create(builder, loc, value);
  }

  for (auto [i, value] : deferredChainOps) {
    Value newValue = MOGG::AsyncReadyOp::create(builder, loc);
    value.replaceUsesWithIf(
        newValue, [&](OpOperand &use) { return use.getOwner() == terminator; });

    // Sink chains so a sole chain output isn't DCE-ed.
    if (!isa<MOGG::AsyncReadyOp>(value.getDefiningOp()))
      MOGG::ChainSinkOp::create(builder, loc, value);
  }
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MOOpLoweringState
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

SmallVector<Value> MOOpLoweringState::getLoweredOperands() {
  SmallVector<Value> loweredOperands;
  for (Value operand : opBeingLowered->getOperands()) {
    Value loweredInput = loweringState.lookupExecuteLoweredValue(operand);

    if (isa<MO::TensorType>(operand.getType()) ||
        isa<MO::BufferType>(operand.getType())) {
      BufferizedTensor bufferizedInput = getBufferizedInput(operand);
      loweredOperands.push_back(bufferizedInput.buffer);
    } else {
      loweredOperands.push_back(loweredInput);
    }
  }
  return loweredOperands;
}

Value MOOpLoweringState::getGuardChain(Value chain) {
  SmallVector<Value> inputChains;
  for (Value operand : opBeingLowered->getOperands()) {
    if (Value c = loweringState.getChainGuardingValueOrNull(operand))
      inputChains.push_back(c);
  }
  if (!inputChains.empty()) {
    inputChains.push_back(chain);
    chain = create<GRT::ChainCreateOp>(inputChains).getResult();
  }
  return chain;
}

FailureOr<SmallVector<MOOutputStorage>>
MOOpLoweringState::createOutputStorage(Value inChain) {
  FailureOr<SmallVector<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>>> outSpecsOr =
      createOutputTensorSpecs();
  if (failed(outSpecsOr))
    return failure();
  return createOutputStorage(inChain, outSpecsOr.value());
}

FailureOr<SmallVector<MOOutputStorage>> MOOpLoweringState::createOutputStorage(
    Value inChain, ArrayRef<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>> outSpecs) {
  SmallVector<BufferizedTensor> bufferizedTensors;
  bufferizedTensors.reserve(outSpecs.size());

  // In-place allocations get no mgp storage.
  DenseSet<int> inplaceAllocIndicesSet;

  SmallVector<Value> results;
  for (auto [idx, res] : llvm::enumerate(opBeingLowered->getResults())) {
    if (!inplaceAllocIndicesSet.contains(idx) &&
        !isa<MO::ChainType, MO::OpaqueType>(res.getType()))
      results.push_back(opBeingLowered->getResult(idx));
  }

  for (auto [spec, result] : llvm::zip(outSpecs, results)) {
    auto bufOr = createBuffer(inChain, spec, result.getType());
    if (failed(bufOr))
      return failure();
    bufferizedTensors.emplace_back(*bufOr);
  }
  return bufferizedTensors;
}

void MOOpLoweringState::createOutputs(
    Value inChain, SmallVector<MOOutputStorage> &loweredOutputsStorage) {
  for (const auto &[idx, outputStorage] :
       llvm::enumerate(loweredOutputsStorage)) {
    createOutputTensor(opBeingLowered->getResult(idx), inChain,
                       outputStorage.buffer, outputStorage.tensorSpec);
  }
}

BufferizedTensor MOOpLoweringState::getBufferizedInput(Value moTensor) {
  Value loweredTensor = loweringState.lookupExecuteLoweredValue(moTensor);
  ASSERT_STREAM(loweredTensor, << "referenced SSA value has not been lowered");

  MO::TensorType ty = MO::castFromTensorLike(moTensor.getType());
  MGPBufferBuilder &bufferBuilder = getStorageBufferBuilder(ty);
  auto buffer = bufferBuilder.tensorExtractBuffer(builder, loc, loweredTensor);
  auto tensorSpec =
      bufferBuilder.tensorExtractTensorSpec(builder, loc, loweredTensor);

  // The buffer shares the tensor's chain.
  loweringState.guardValueWithChain(
      buffer, loweringState.getChainGuardingValueOrNull(loweredTensor));

  return BufferizedTensor(buffer, tensorSpec);
}

FailureOr<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>>
MOOpLoweringState::createTensorSpec(MO::TensorType moTensorType) {
  MGP::TensorSpecType tensorSpecType = MGP::createTensorSpecType(moTensorType);
  if (tensorSpecType.getSizeInBytes()) {
    return MGP::TensorSpecCreateOp::create(builder, loc,
                                           /*spec=*/tensorSpecType)
        .getResult();
  }

  auto runtimeDimsOr = loweringState.lowerShapeAttrDynDims(
      opBeingLowered->getParentRegion(), moTensorType.getShape(), loc);
  if (runtimeDimsOr)
    return opBeingLowered->emitOpError(runtimeDimsOr.getError());
  return MGP::TensorSpecCreateOp::create(builder, loc,
                                         /*spec=*/tensorSpecType,
                                         /*runtimeDims=*/*runtimeDimsOr)
      .getResult();
}

FailureOr<SmallVector<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>>>
MOOpLoweringState::createOutputTensorSpecs() {
  SmallVector<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>> tensorSpecs;
  tensorSpecs.reserve(opBeingLowered->getNumResults());

  DenseSet<int> inplaceAllocIndicesSet;

  for (auto [idx, type] :
       llvm::enumerate(opBeingLowered->getResults().getType())) {
    if (inplaceAllocIndicesSet.contains(idx))
      continue;

    // The kernel lowering handles these separately.
    if (isa<MO::ChainType, MO::OpaqueType, MOGG::ShapeFuncResultType>(type))
      continue;

    auto moTensorType = dyn_cast<MO::TensorType>(type);
    ASSERT_STREAM(moTensorType, << "result of op is not a !mo.tensor");
    FailureOr<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>> tensorSpecOr =
        createTensorSpec(moTensorType);
    if (failed(tensorSpecOr))
      return failure();
    tensorSpecs.emplace_back(*tensorSpecOr);
  }
  return tensorSpecs;
}

FailureOr<BufferizedTensor> MOOpLoweringState::createBuffer(
    Value inChain, TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec, Type tensorType) {
  MGPBufferBuilder &bufferBuilder = getStorageBufferBuilder(tensorType);
  MO::TensorType moTensorType = MO::dynCastFromTensorLike(tensorType);
  ASSERT_STREAM(moTensorType, << "input is not a !mo.tensor or !mo.buffer");

  Value numBytes = bufferSizeBytes(tensorSpec, moTensorType);

  auto bufferDevice = bufferBuilder.getDevice();
  auto preferredAlignment =
      M::Driver::getPreferredAlignment(bufferDevice.getLabel().str());
  if (bufferDevice.getLabel() == M::kCPULabel)
    preferredAlignment = std::gcd(preferredAlignment, minimumCpuAlignment);
  auto deviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(bufferDevice);
  return BufferizedTensor(
      bufferBuilder.bufferAlloc(builder, loc, context, inChain, numBytes,
                                deviceContext, preferredAlignment),
      tensorSpec);
}

void MOOpLoweringState::createOutputTensor(
    Value moTensor, Value inChain, Value buffer,
    TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType> tensorSpec) {
  bool isMut = isa<MO::BufferType>(moTensor.getType());

  Value loweredTensor =
      getStorageBufferBuilder(moTensor.getType())
          .tensorCreate(builder, loc, context, inChain, buffer, tensorSpec,
                        /*mut=*/isMut);
  loweringState.emplaceExecuteLoweredBufferValue(moTensor, loweredTensor,
                                                 inChain);
}

void MOOpLoweringState::createOutputTensors(
    Value inChain, SmallVector<Value> &buffers,
    SmallVector<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>> &tensorSpecs) {
  for (const auto &[idx, buffer, tensorSpec] :
       llvm::enumerate(buffers, tensorSpecs))
    createOutputTensor(opBeingLowered->getResult(idx), inChain, buffer,
                       tensorSpec);
}

MGPBufferBuilder &
MOOpLoweringState::getStorageBufferBuilder(Type moTensorType) {
  auto type = MO::dynCastFromTensorLike(moTensorType);
  ASSERT_STREAM(type, << "expecting a !mo.tensor or !mo.buffer type");
  return loweringState.getBufferBuilder(MO::getDeviceOrDefault(type));
}

#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Dialect/MGPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Dialect/MGPUtils.h"

using namespace M;

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MGPBufferBuilder
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> MGPBufferBuilder::setupForModel(
    ModelOp modelOp, MGPBufferBuilder *hostBufferBuilder, OpBuilder &builder,
    Location loc, TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain) {
  this->hostBufferBuilder = hostBufferBuilder;

  TypedValue<ContextType> context;
  modelOp.walk([&](ContextCreateOp contextCreateOp) {
    runtimeSlot = contextCreateOp.getNumSlots();
    contextCreateOp.setNumSlots(runtimeSlot + 1);
    context = contextCreateOp.getResult();
    return WalkResult::interrupt();
  });

  if (this->hostBufferBuilder == this) {
    auto runtime = MGP::RuntimeCreateOp::create(builder, loc,
                                                /*inChain=*/inChain,
                                                /*theContext=*/context,
                                                /*aRuntimeSlot=*/runtimeSlot);
    ;
    return runtime.getOutChain();
  }
  return inChain;
}

void MGPBufferBuilder::recoverFromModel(ModelOp modelOp,
                                        MGPBufferBuilder *hostBufferBuilder) {
  this->hostBufferBuilder = hostBufferBuilder;

  // Without an mgp.runtime.create (unit tests), the slot index stays 0.
  modelOp.walk([&](RuntimeCreateOp runtimeCreateOp) {
    runtimeSlot = runtimeCreateOp.getARuntimeSlot();
    return WalkResult::interrupt();
  });

  size_t moduleIndex = 0;
  modelOp.walk([&](ModuleLoadOp moduleLoadOp) {
    for (auto [functionIndex, name] :
         llvm::enumerate(moduleLoadOp.getCFunctionSymbols())) {
      functionToIndexPair[name] = std::make_pair(moduleIndex, functionIndex);
    }
    for (auto [constantIndex, name] :
         llvm::enumerate(moduleLoadOp.getDConstantSymbols())) {
      constantToIndexPair[name] = std::make_pair(moduleIndex, constantIndex);
    }
    ++moduleIndex;
  });
}

TypedValue<ContextType> MGPBufferBuilder::getContextForOp(Operation *op) {
  if (auto hasSlotOp = dyn_cast<MGPHasRuntimeSlotOpInterface>(op))
    return hasSlotOp.getTheContext();
  return getContextForBlock(op->getBlock());
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferConstant(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                       TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                                       TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                                       ElementsAttr value) {
  return BufferConstantOp::create(builder, loc, /*aValue=*/value);
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferConstantExternal(
    OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
    TypedValue<ContextType> context,
    TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> weightsRegistry,
    TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> name, uint64_t size, uint64_t align,
    bool hasAlias, bool isPlaceholder) {
  return BufferConstantExternalOp::create(builder, loc,
                                          /*inChain=*/inChain,
                                          /*weightsRegistry=*/weightsRegistry,
                                          /*name=*/name,
                                          /*aSize=*/size,
                                          /*bAlign=*/align,
                                          /*cDevice=*/device,
                                          /*dHasAlias=*/hasAlias,
                                          /*eIsPlaceholder=*/isPlaceholder);
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::tensorExtractBuffer(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                            Value tensor) {
  return builder.createOrFold<TensorExtractBufferOp>(
      loc,
      /*tensor=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceTensorType>>(tensor));
}

TypedValue<TensorSpecType>
MGPBufferBuilder::tensorExtractTensorSpec(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                          Value tensor) {
  return dyn_cast<TypedValue<TensorSpecType>>(
      builder.createOrFold<TensorExtractTensorSpecOp>(
          loc,
          /*tensor=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceTensorType>>(tensor)));
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::tensorCreate(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                     TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                                     Value inChain, Value buffer,
                                     TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec,
                                     bool mut) {
  auto deviceBuffer = cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(buffer);
  return TensorCreateOp::create(builder, loc,
                                /*inChain=*/inChain,
                                /*buffer=*/deviceBuffer,
                                /*tensorSpec=*/tensorSpec,
                                /*mut=*/mut);
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferAlloc(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                    TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                                    Value inChain, Value size,
                                    Value deviceContext, uint64_t alignment) {
  return BufferAllocOp::create(builder, loc, DeviceBufferType::get(device),
                               /*inChain=*/inChain,
                               /*runtimeSize=*/size,
                               /*deviceContext=*/deviceContext,
                               /*bAlign=*/alignment,
                               /*cDevice=*/device);
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferTransferFromHost(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                               TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                                               Value inChain,
                                               MGPBufferBuilder *srcBuilder,
                                               Value srcBuffer, Value dstBuffer,
                                               Value deviceContext) {
  Value copyChain =
      BufferHostToDeviceOp::create(
          builder, loc,
          /*inChain=*/inChain,
          /*hostBuffer=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(srcBuffer),
          /*otherBuffer=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(dstBuffer),
          /*deviceContext*/
          cast<TypedValue<DeviceContextType>>(deviceContext),
          /*cHostDevice=*/hostBufferBuilder->device,
          /*dOtherDevice=*/device)
          .getResult();

  Value syncChain =
      MGP::SyncOp::create(builder, loc, copyChain, context, deviceContext,
                          /*bDevice=*/device);

  MGP::ExtendLifetimeOp::create(builder, loc, syncChain, ValueRange{srcBuffer});
  // Return copyChain, not syncChain: ops on the same deviceContext are
  // stream-ordered after the h2d copy, and waiting on syncChain would block
  // enqueueing ahead. A d2d copy using this dst as its src runs on another
  // stream, so it does not get that ordering for free.
  return copyChain;
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferTransferToHost(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                             TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                                             Value inChain, Value srcBuffer,
                                             MGPBufferBuilder *dstBuilder,
                                             Value dstBuffer,
                                             Value deviceContext) {
  Value copyChain =
      BufferDeviceToHostOp::create(
          builder, loc,
          /*inChain=*/inChain,
          /*otherBuffer=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(srcBuffer),
          /*hostBuffer=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(dstBuffer),
          /*deviceContext*/
          cast<TypedValue<DeviceContextType>>(deviceContext),
          /*cOtherDevice=*/device,
          /*dHostDevice=*/hostBufferBuilder->device)
          .getResult();
  Value syncChain =
      MGP::SyncOp::create(builder, loc, copyChain, context, deviceContext,
                          /*bDevice*/ device);

  MGP::ExtendLifetimeOp::create(builder, loc, syncChain, ValueRange{dstBuffer});

  // The host cannot read dstBuffer until the d2h copy completes.
  return syncChain;
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferTransferDevice(
    OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, TypedValue<ContextType> context,
    Value inChain, Value srcBuffer, MGPBufferBuilder *dstBufferBuilder,
    Value dstBuffer, Value srcDeviceContext, Value dstDeviceContext) {
  DeviceRefAttr srcDevice = device;
  DeviceRefAttr dstDevice = dstBufferBuilder->device;

  // Different (virtual) devices use different streams, so the copy (on the
  // destination stream) is synchronized with the source stream via
  // mgp.device_wait on both sides.
  bool needsCrossStreamSync = srcDevice != dstDevice;

  Value copyInChain = inChain;
  if (needsCrossStreamSync) {
    // Source data must be ready before the copy reads it.
    copyInChain =
        MGP::DeviceWaitOp::create(builder, loc, /*inChain=*/inChain, context,
                                  /*waitingDeviceContext=*/dstDeviceContext,
                                  /*signalingDeviceContext=*/srcDeviceContext,
                                  /*bDevice=*/dstDevice)
            .getResult();
  }

  Value copyChain =
      BufferDeviceToDeviceOp::create(
          builder, loc,
          /*inChain=*/copyInChain,
          /*srcBuffer=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(srcBuffer),
          /*dstBuffer=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(dstBuffer),
          /*deviceContext*/
          cast<TypedValue<DeviceContextType>>(srcDeviceContext),
          /*deviceContext*/
          cast<TypedValue<DeviceContextType>>(dstDeviceContext),
          /*cSrcDevice=*/srcDevice,
          /*dDstDevice=*/dstDevice)
          .getResult();

  if (!needsCrossStreamSync)
    return copyChain;

  // The source must not be overwritten or freed until the copy completes.
  return MGP::DeviceWaitOp::create(builder, loc, /*inChain=*/copyChain, context,
                                   /*waitingDeviceContext=*/srcDeviceContext,
                                   /*signalingDeviceContext=*/dstDeviceContext,
                                   /*bDevice=*/srcDevice)
      .getResult();
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferGetSize(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,

  return builder.createOrFold<BufferGetSizeOp>(

      /*inBuffer=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(inBuffer));

/// Returns arrayAttr, which should be an array of StringAttrs, encoded as
/// a MultiLineStringAttr. Also adds each string to the given map.
static MultiLineStringAttr
toMultiline(OpBuilder &builder, uint64_t moduleIndex, ArrayAttr arrayAttr,
            llvm::StringMap<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> &nameToIndexPair) {
  SmallVector<StringAttr> stringAttrs;
  if (arrayAttr) {
    uint64_t nameIndex = 0;
    for (StringRef symbol : arrayAttr.getAsValueRange<mlir::StringAttr>()) {
      stringAttrs.emplace_back(builder.getStringAttr(symbol));
      nameToIndexPair.insert({symbol, std::make_pair(moduleIndex, nameIndex)});
      ++nameIndex;
    }
  }
  return MultiLineStringAttr::get(builder.getContext(), stringAttrs);
}

TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> MGPBufferBuilder::moduleLoad(
    OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, TypedValue<ContextType> context,
    TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain, ElementsAttr image,
    ArrayAttr functionSymbols, ArrayAttr constantSymbols) {
  auto functionSymbolsAttr = toMultiline(builder, nextModuleIndex,
                                         functionSymbols, functionToIndexPair);
  auto constantSymbolsAttr = toMultiline(builder, nextModuleIndex,
                                         constantSymbols, constantToIndexPair);
  auto load = ModuleLoadOp::create(builder, loc,
                                   /*inChain=*/
                                   cast<TypedValue<MEF::ChainType>>(inChain),
                                   /*theContext=*/context,
                                   /*aRuntimeSlot=*/runtimeSlot,
                                   /*bImage=*/image,
                                   /*cFunctionSymbols=*/functionSymbolsAttr,
                                   /*dConstantSymbols=*/constantSymbolsAttr,
                                   /*eDevice=*/device,
                                   /*fModuleIndex=*/nextModuleIndex);
  ++nextModuleIndex;
  return load;
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::chainCreate(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                    ArrayRef<Value> inChains) {
  return GRT::ChainCreateOp::create(builder, loc, inChains);
}

std::pair<TypedValue<MEF::ChainType>, uint64_t>
MGPBufferBuilder::cache(OpBuilder &initBuilder, Location loc,
                        TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                        TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                        ContextCreateOp contextCreateOp, Value buffer) {
  uint64_t bufferSlot = contextCreateOp.getNumSlots();
  contextCreateOp.setNumSlots(bufferSlot + 1);
  auto cacheOp = BufferCacheOp::create(
      initBuilder, loc, /*inChain=*/inChain, /*theContext=*/contextCreateOp,
      /*buffer=*/cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(buffer),
      /*bBufferSlot=*/bufferSlot);
  return {cacheOp.getOutChain(), bufferSlot};
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::getCached(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                  TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                                  TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                                  uint64_t bufferSlot,
                                  Type expectedBufferType) {
  auto parentOp = builder.getBlock()->getParentOp();
  if (!isa<ModelOp>(parentOp))
    parentOp = parentOp->getParentOfType<MGP::ModelOp>();

  auto modelOp = cast<ModelOp>(parentOp);
  Value bufferSlotIndex =
      mlir::index::ConstantOp::create(builder, loc, bufferSlot);
  if (modelOp.getIsSubgraph()) {
    bufferSlotIndex = mlir::index::AddOp::create(builder, loc, bufferSlotIndex,
                                                 modelOp.getSubgraphIndex());
  }

  return BufferGetCachedOp::create(builder, loc, expectedBufferType,
                                   /*inChain=*/inChain, /*theContext=*/context,
                                   /*bBufferSlot=*/bufferSlotIndex)
      .getOutBuffer();
}

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferConcat(

  return BufferConcatOp::create(

      /*inBuffers=*/inBuffers, deviceContext,
      /*bDevice=*/device);

Value MGPBufferBuilder::bufferSetWithIndex(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,

Value MGPBufferBuilder::sync(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                             TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                             TypedValue<DeviceContextType> deviceContext,
                             Value chain) {
  return MGP::SyncOp::create(builder, loc, chain, context, deviceContext,
                             /*bDevice*/ device)
      .getResult();
}

using namespace M;
using namespace MGP;

/// The device a tensor/buffer graph input lives on. Both types default their
/// `#M.device_ref` parameter to the host, so an omitted device reads as CPU.
static DeviceRefAttr graphInputDevice(Value v) {
  return llvm::TypeSwitch<Type, DeviceRefAttr>(v.getType())
      .Case<MGP::DeviceTensorType, MGP::DeviceBufferType>(
          [](auto type) { return type.getDevice(); })
      .Default(nullptr);
}

/// Is `v` a device-resident graph input rather than a context operand?
/// (`inputs` also carries `!mgp.context` and `!mgp.device_context` values.)
///
/// Must agree with `graphInputData` in MGPPrimitives.cpp, or inputs pair with
/// the wrong stable buffers at replay. Mutable inputs register a null in-place
/// marker so every device input keeps one position in `graph->getInputs()`.
static bool isDeviceGraphInput(Value v) {
  return graphInputDevice(v) != nullptr;
}

/// Host tensor inputs are assumed to encode launch parameters, so their
/// contents join the cache key. Warn on large ones, which bloat the cache,
/// until there is a knob to control this.
static constexpr uint64_t kHostInputWarnBytes = 1024;

/// Verifies the residency rules for the graph's tensor/buffer inputs.
///
/// - Device-resident tensors are copied into device-pool stable locations (or
///   recorded in place when `mut`).
///
/// - Host-placed *immutable* tensors are allowed: they get a host-pool stable
///   location populated before recording, and their contents join the cache
///   key, because recorded ops read host values at enqueue time.
///
/// - Host-placed `mut` tensors are rejected (in-place writes would invalidate
///   their own cache entry), as are host-placed raw buffers, which should
///   already be lowered to mut tensors.
static LogicalResult verifyInputResidency(Operation *op, OperandRange inputs) {
  for (auto [idx, input] : llvm::enumerate(inputs)) {
    DeviceRefAttr device = graphInputDevice(input);
    if (!device || !M::isHostPlaced(device))
      continue;

    auto tensorType = dyn_cast<MGP::DeviceTensorType>(input.getType());
    if (!tensorType)
      return op->emitOpError("input #")
             << idx << " is a buffer on " << device.toString()
             << ", but host-placed device graph inputs must be immutable "
                "tensors";
    if (tensorType.getMut())
      return op->emitOpError("input #")
             << idx << " is a mutable tensor on " << device.toString()
             << "; in-place writes contradict the value-keyed replay of a "
                "host-placed input";

    std::optional<uint64_t> byteSize =
        tensorType.getTensorSpec().getSizeInBytes();
    if (!byteSize)
      continue; // Dynamic shape: the runtime keys whatever size shows up.
    if (*byteSize > kHostInputWarnBytes)
      op->emitWarning("input #")
          << idx << " is a host tensor of " << *byteSize
          << " bytes; its contents are baked into the graph cache key, so "
             "every distinct value records a new graph";
  }
  return success();
}

// Emits `var cache_N = Pointer(to=<ctx>.get_device_graph_cache())`.
// `DeviceGraphCache` is not copyable, so the returned reference cannot be bound
// to a `var` directly; `DeviceGraph.create` takes it by pointer.
LogicalResult DeviceGraphCacheOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  using namespace MOGG;

  MojoValue theContext = state.getMojoValueFor(getTheContext());
  MojoValue cache = state.builder.var(MojoValue(kStructPointer)(
      /*parameters=*/{},
      /*operands=*/{
          MojoValue(kParameterTo)
              .equal(StateContextRef(theContext).getDeviceGraphCache())}));
  state.setMojoValueFor(getOutCache(), cache);
  return success();
}

bool DeviceGraphCacheOp::isThrows() { return true; }

void DeviceGraphYieldOp::build(OpBuilder &, OperationState &) {
  // No-operand stub for the parent's `SingleBlockImplicitTerminator`; operands
  // are populated after insertion.
}

// Packs each yielded value into an `AsyncValue` and passes it to `add_output`
// so its backing memory outlives the graph that references it.
LogicalResult DeviceGraphYieldOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  using namespace MOGG;

  // The builder is the first block argument of the enclosing `create` body.
  Value builderArg = getOperation()->getBlock()->getArgument(0);
  DeviceGraphBuilderRef builder(state.getMojoValueFor(builderArg));

  for (Value output : getOutputs()) {
    MojoValue outVal = state.getMojoValueFor(output);
    MojoValue asyncValue =
        outVal.get(kFnAsyncPack)(/*parameters=*/{}, /*operands=*/{});
    state.builder.call(builder.addOutput(),
                       /*parameters=*/{}, /*operands=*/{asyncValue});
  }
  return success();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// DeviceGraphAllocOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

LogicalResult DeviceGraphAllocOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  using namespace MOGG;
  // The primitive's `sym_name` (set by ImportPackages) is the Mojo function.
  auto primDecl = state.registry.lookupPrimitive(getOperationName());
  MojoValue function(primDecl.getSymNameAttr().strref());

  DeviceRefAttr hostDevice = M::getHostDevice(getContext());
  MojoValue isHostParam(getOutBuffer().getType().getDevice() == hostDevice);
  MojoValue result = state.builder.var(function(
      /*parameters=*/{isHostParam},
      /*operands=*/{state.getMojoValueFor(getRuntimeSize()),
                    state.getMojoValueFor(getGraphBuilder())}));
  state.setMojoValueFor(getOutBuffer(), result);
  return success();
}

// DeviceGraphDependenciesOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::getYieldOp() {
  return cast<DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp>(
      getBody().front().getTerminator());
}

TypedValue<DeviceGraphBuilderType>
DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::getBuilderBlockArgument() {
  return cast<TypedValue<DeviceGraphBuilderType>>(
      getBody().front().getArgument(0));
}

LogicalResult DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::verify() {
  // The sole block argument is the `!mgp.device_graph.builder` that the body's
  // device-context uses are re-sourced from.
  Block &body = getBody().front();
  if (body.getNumArguments() != 1)
    return emitOpError("body has ")
           << body.getNumArguments()
           << " block argument(s), expected exactly 1 (the "
              "`!mgp.device_graph.builder`)";
  if (!llvm::isa<DeviceGraphBuilderType>(body.getArgument(0).getType()))
    return emitOpError("body argument #0 must be a "
                       "`!mgp.device_graph.builder`, but is ")
           << body.getArgument(0).getType();

  // The yield's operands must match this op's `bodyResults`.
  DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp yieldOp = getYieldOp();
  if (!llvm::equal(yieldOp.getOperands().getTypes(),
                   getBodyResults().getTypes()))
    return emitOpError(
        "`mgp.device_graph.dependencies.yield` operand types must "
        "match the op's body result types");
  return success();
}

LogicalResult DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::fold(FoldAdaptor,
                                              SmallVectorImpl<OpFoldResult> &) {
  llvm::SmallSetVector<Value, 8> deduped;
  deduped.insert_range(getDependencies());

  if (deduped.size() == getDependencies().size())
    return failure();

  getDependenciesMutable().assign(deduped.getArrayRef());
  return success();
}

void DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::build(
    OpBuilder &builder, OperationState &result, Value graphBuilder,
    ValueRange dependencies,
    llvm::function_ref<void(OpBuilder &, Location, Value)> bodyBuilder) {
  OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(builder);

  result.addOperands(graphBuilder);
  result.addOperands(dependencies);

  // The synthesized node is always the first result.
  result.addTypes(DeviceGraphNodeType::get(builder.getContext()));

  // The callback populates the body and is expected to emit the
  // dependencies.yield. The body otherwise references enclosing SSA directly.
  Region *bodyRegion = result.addRegion();
  Block *body = builder.createBlock(bodyRegion);
  Value builderArg = body->addArgument(
      DeviceGraphBuilderType::get(builder.getContext()), result.location);
  if (bodyBuilder)
    bodyBuilder(builder, result.location, builderArg);

  // Supply the operandless terminator (no body results) if the callback did not
  // emit one.
  if (!body->mightHaveTerminator())
    ensureTerminator(*bodyRegion, builder, result.location);

  // The remaining results are exactly the dependencies.yield operands.
  auto yieldOp = cast<DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp>(body->getTerminator());
  result.addTypes(yieldOp.getOperands().getTypes());
}

bool DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::producesNewNodes() {
  return !getBuilderBlockArgument().use_empty();
}

// Emits `var node_N = <builder>.region(work_N, dependencies=[...])`, where
// `work_N` is a recording closure wrapping the body. The body captures
// enclosing values lexically; only the builder block arg is a closure
// parameter. `dependencies=` makes the edges predecessors of the first node the
// body records (`_implicit_deps`); `region` chains the rest in body order.
//
// `region` returns only the body's last node, so each in-body result is
// surfaced through a captured outer `Optional[T]` var (the type may not be
// default-constructible, e.g. a non-null buffer pointer):
//
//   var out = Optional[T](None)
//   def work(mut builder) raises {mut}:
//     ...
//     out = <yielded>
//   var node = builder.region(work, dependencies=[...])
//   var resolved = out.take()
//   // uses of the op's body result now refer to `resolved`
LogicalResult DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  using namespace MOGG;

  Value builderArg = getBuilderBlockArgument();
  DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp yieldOp = getYieldOp();

  // Partition the used body results into those produced inside the body (which
  // need a captured outer var) and external pass-throughs (bound directly).
  struct SurfacedResult {
    Value result;
    Value yielded;
    MojoValue outVar;
  };

  SmallVector<SurfacedResult> surfaced;
  for (auto [result, yielded] :
       llvm::zip_equal(getBodyResults(), yieldOp.getOperands())) {
    if (result.use_empty())
      continue;

    MojoValue optionalType = MojoValue(
        kStructOptional)[EmitMojoState::mlirTypeToMojoType(result.getType())];
    MojoValue outVar =
        state.builder.var(optionalType(/*parameters=*/{},
                                       /*operands=*/{MojoValue(kComptimeNone)}),
                          /*cache=*/false);
    surfaced.emplace_back(result, yielded, outVar);
  }

  NamedMojoDef builderParam =
      NamedMojoDef::asVerbatim("builder", MojoValue(kStructDeviceGraphBuilder));
  builderParam.argConvention = "mut";

  // Surfacing closures write their `Optional` vars, so capture by `mut`. One
  // that also reads register-passable captures would need per-capture
  // conventions; current single-dispatch bodies do not.
  llvm::StringRef workConvention =
      surfaced.empty() ? llvm::StringRef("imm") : llvm::StringRef("mut");

  bool errOccurred = false;
  MojoValue workClosure = state.builder.lambda(
      "work", /*parameters=*/{}, /*arguments=*/{builderParam},
      /*returnType=*/std::nullopt,
      // Never inline: single-use per-kernel bodies otherwise merge into the
      // build closure (see the build lambda in DeviceGraphCreateOp).
      MojoBuilder::LambdaInline::kNever,
      /*isAsync=*/false, /*raises=*/true, /*captureConvention=*/workConvention,
      [&](const FunctionBody &functionBody) {
        state.setMojoValueFor(builderArg, functionBody.arguments.front());
        for (Operation &op : getBodyBlock().getOperations())
          if (state.lowerOpToMojo(&op).failed()) {
            errOccurred = true;
            return;
          }
        for (const SurfacedResult &s : surfaced)
          state.builder.assign(s.outVar,
                               state.getMojoValueFor(s.yielded).transfer());
      });
  if (errOccurred)
    return failure();

  SmallVector<MojoValue> depValues = state.getMojoValuesFor(getDependencies());
  MojoValue dependenciesList = state.builder.listLiteral(depValues);

  DeviceGraphBuilderRef builder(state.getMojoValueFor(getGraphBuilder()));
  MojoValue node =
      state.builder.var(builder.region(workClosure, dependenciesList));
  state.setMojoValueFor(getNode(), node);

  for (const SurfacedResult &s : surfaced)
    state.setMojoValueFor(s.result, state.builder.var(s.outVar.get("take")(
                                        /*parameters=*/{}, /*operands=*/{})));

  return success();
}

Block &DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::getBodyBlock() { return getBody().front(); }

bool DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::isThrows() { return true; }

namespace {

/// Rebuilds an `mgp.device_graph.dependencies` op with new body results and
/// yield operands, keeping the `node` result and dependency edges.
/// `bodyResultReplacement(i)` maps original body result `i` to its position
/// among the new body results.
DeviceGraphDependenciesOp
rebuildWithBodyResults(PatternRewriter &rewriter, DeviceGraphDependenciesOp op,
                       TypeRange newBodyResultTypes,
                       ValueRange newYieldOperands,
                       ArrayRef<unsigned> bodyResultRemap) {
  SmallVector<Type> newResultTypes;
  newResultTypes.push_back(op.getNode().getType());
  llvm::append_range(newResultTypes, newBodyResultTypes);

  auto newOp = DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::create(
      rewriter, op.getLoc(), TypeRange(newResultTypes), op.getGraphBuilder(),
      op.getDependencies());
  newOp.getBody().takeBody(op.getBody());
  DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp newYield = newOp.getYieldOp();
  rewriter.modifyOpInPlace(newYield, [&]() {
    newYield.getOperandsMutable().assign(newYieldOperands);
  });

  SmallVector<Value> replacements(op.getNumResults());
  replacements[0] = newOp.getNode();
  for (auto [idx, result] : llvm::enumerate(op.getBodyResults())) {
    if (result.use_empty())
      continue;
    replacements[idx + 1] = newOp.getResult(bodyResultRemap[idx] + 1);
  }
  rewriter.replaceOp(op, replacements);
  return newOp;
}

/// Drops unused body results of an `mgp.device_graph.dependencies` op and the
/// matching yield operands. The `node` result (the ordering edge) is kept.
struct RemoveUnusedDependenciesResults
    : public OpRewritePattern<DeviceGraphDependenciesOp> {
  using OpRewritePattern::OpRewritePattern;

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(DeviceGraphDependenciesOp op,
                                PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    SmallVector<unsigned> usedResultIndices;
    SmallVector<Type> usedResultTypes;
    for (auto [idx, result] : llvm::enumerate(op.getBodyResults())) {
      if (!result.use_empty()) {
        usedResultIndices.push_back(idx);
        usedResultTypes.push_back(result.getType());
      }
    }

    if (usedResultIndices.size() == op.getBodyResults().size())
      return failure();

    DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp oldYield = op.getYieldOp();
    auto newYieldOperands =
        llvm::map_to_vector(usedResultIndices, [&](unsigned idx) -> Value {
          return oldYield.getOperand(idx);
        });

    SmallVector<unsigned> remap(op.getBodyResults().size());
    for (auto [newIdx, oldIdx] : llvm::enumerate(usedResultIndices))
      remap[oldIdx] = newIdx;

    rebuildWithBodyResults(rewriter, op, TypeRange(usedResultTypes),
                           newYieldOperands, remap);
    return success();
  }
};

/// De-duplicates body results of an `mgp.device_graph.dependencies` op whose
/// yield carries the same value more than once.
struct DeduplicateDependenciesResults
    : public OpRewritePattern<DeviceGraphDependenciesOp> {
  using OpRewritePattern::OpRewritePattern;

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(DeviceGraphDependenciesOp op,
                                PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp oldYield = op.getYieldOp();

    unsigned numElements = oldYield.getNumOperands();

    llvm::SmallMapVector<Value, unsigned, 8> firstOccurrence;
    firstOccurrence.reserve(numElements);

    SmallVector<unsigned> resultRemap(op.getBodyResults().size());

    for (auto [idx, operand] : llvm::enumerate(oldYield.getOperands())) {
      auto [it, _] =
          firstOccurrence.try_emplace(operand, firstOccurrence.size());
      resultRemap[idx] = it->second;
    }

    if (firstOccurrence.size() == op.getBodyResults().size())
      return failure();

    auto dedupedOperands = llvm::to_vector(firstOccurrence.keys());
    rebuildWithBodyResults(rewriter, op, TypeRange(dedupedOperands),
                           dedupedOperands, resultRemap);
    return success();
  }
};

/// Forwards `mgp.device_graph.dependencies` body results whose
/// `dependencies.yield` operand is produced *outside* the body region.
/// Rewriting those uses leaves the result dead for
/// `RemoveUnusedDependenciesResults` to drop.
struct ForwardExternalDependenciesResults
    : public OpRewritePattern<DeviceGraphDependenciesOp> {
  using OpRewritePattern::OpRewritePattern;

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(DeviceGraphDependenciesOp op,
                                PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    Region &body = op.getBody();
    DeviceGraphDependenciesYieldOp yieldOp = op.getYieldOp();

    bool changed = false;
    for (auto [result, yielded] :
         llvm::zip(op.getBodyResults(), yieldOp.getOperands())) {
      // Skipping dead results keeps the pattern idempotent; otherwise the
      // greedy driver never converges.
      if (result.use_empty())
        continue;

      // Only forward pass-throughs of outer SSA (block args count as inside).
      if (body.isAncestor(yielded.getParentRegion()))
        continue;

      rewriter.replaceAllUsesWith(result, yielded);
      changed = true;
    }
    return success(changed);
  }
};

/// Hoists body ops whose operands are all defined outside the body in front of
/// an `mgp.device_graph.dependencies` op, so the `work` closure captures them
/// once instead of recomputing them on every graph build. Hoisting is
/// transitive within one sweep; builder-dependent ops stay in the body.
struct HoistOperations final
    : public OpRewritePattern<DeviceGraphDependenciesOp> {
  using OpRewritePattern::OpRewritePattern;

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(DeviceGraphDependenciesOp dependenciesOp,
                                PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    Region &body = dependenciesOp.getBody();

    auto isRegionCapture = [&body](Value operand) {
      return body.isAncestor(operand.getParentRegion());
    };

    bool changed = false;
    for (Operation &op : llvm::make_early_inc_range(body.getOps())) {
      if (op.hasTrait<OpTrait::IsTerminator>())
        continue;

      WalkResult result = op.walk([&](Operation *inner) -> WalkResult {
        bool canHoist = llvm::none_of(inner->getOperands(), isRegionCapture);

        if (!canHoist)
          return WalkResult::interrupt();
        return WalkResult::advance();
      });

      if (!result.wasInterrupted()) {
        rewriter.moveOpBefore(&op, dependenciesOp);
        changed = true;
      }
    }

    return success(changed);
  }
};

/// Absorbs the body of an `mgp.device_graph.dependencies` op into its sole
/// successor, when the two form a link in a linear chain.
struct MergeChainedDependencies final
    : public OpRewritePattern<DeviceGraphDependenciesOp> {
  using Base::Base;

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(DeviceGraphDependenciesOp op,
                                PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    // With exactly one edge, absorbing the producer adds no ordering. With
    // more, the absorbed body would be ordered after the other edges too.
    if (op.getDependencies().size() != 1)
      return failure();

    auto producer =
        op.getDependencies().front().getDefiningOp<DeviceGraphDependenciesOp>();
    if (!producer)
      return failure();

    if (!producer.getNode().hasOneUse())
      return failure();

    // Dataflow out of the producer is uncommon; bail.
    if (!producer.getBodyResults().empty())
      return failure();

    if (producer.getGraphBuilder() != op.getGraphBuilder() ||
        producer->getBlock() != op->getBlock())
      return failure();

    // The merged block keeps the consumer's terminator.
    rewriter.eraseOp(producer.getYieldOp());

    rewriter.inlineBlockBefore(&producer.getBodyBlock(), &op.getBodyBlock(),
                               op.getBodyBlock().begin(),
                               {op.getBuilderBlockArgument()});

    rewriter.modifyOpInPlace(op, [&] {
      op.getDependenciesMutable().assign(producer.getDependencies());
    });
    rewriter.eraseOp(producer);

    return success();
  }
};

/// Replaces a dependency edge on an empty (node-less) producer with that
/// producer's own edges, preserving transitive ordering. Bypassed ops are left
/// for DCE; duplicate edges are folded by the edge-dedup folder.
struct BypassEmptyDependencies final
    : public OpRewritePattern<DeviceGraphDependenciesOp> {
  using Base::Base;

  /// Returns the transitive dependencies of a node for an empty region.
  static std::optional<ValueRange> getTransitiveDependencies(Value dependency) {
    if (auto producer = dependency.getDefiningOp<DeviceGraphDependenciesOp>())
      if (!producer.producesNewNodes())
        return producer.getDependencies();

    return {};
  }

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(DeviceGraphDependenciesOp dependenciesOp,
                                PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    llvm::SmallVector<Value> newDependencies;

    bool changed = false;
    for (auto dependency : dependenciesOp.getDependencies()) {
      if (auto transitiveDeps = getTransitiveDependencies(dependency)) {
        llvm::append_range(newDependencies, *transitiveDeps);
        changed = true;
      } else {
        newDependencies.push_back(dependency);
      }
    }

    if (!changed)
      return rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(dependenciesOp,
                                         "no dependencies to remove");

    rewriter.modifyOpInPlace(dependenciesOp, [&] {
      dependenciesOp.getDependenciesMutable().assign(newDependencies);
    });

    return success();
  }
};

} // namespace

void DeviceGraphDependenciesOp::getCanonicalizationPatterns(
    RewritePatternSet &patterns, MLIRContext *ctx) {
  // clang-format off
  patterns.add<
    BypassEmptyDependencies,
    DeduplicateDependenciesResults,
    ForwardExternalDependenciesResults,
    HoistOperations,
    MergeChainedDependencies,
    RemoveUnusedDependenciesResults
  >(ctx);
  // clang-format on
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// DeviceGraphStagingOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

DeviceGraphStagingYieldOp DeviceGraphStagingOp::getYieldOp() {
  return cast<DeviceGraphStagingYieldOp>(getBody().front().getTerminator());
}

LogicalResult DeviceGraphStagingOp::verify() {
  Block &body = getBody().front();

  // Block args are [builder, input_0, ..., input_n-1]; inputs carry the
  // `inputs` operand types verbatim (bare `T`, no `!mogg.async`).
  if (body.getNumArguments() != 1 + getInputs().size())
    return emitOpError("staging body has ")
           << body.getNumArguments() << " block argument(s), expected "
           << (1 + getInputs().size())
           << " (the device-graph builder plus one "
              "per input)";
  if (!isa<DeviceGraphBuilderType>(body.getArgument(0).getType()))
    return emitOpError("staging body argument #0 must be a "
                       "`!mgp.device_graph.builder`, but is ")
           << body.getArgument(0).getType();
  for (auto [idx, inputType] : llvm::enumerate(getInputs().getTypes())) {
    Type argType = body.getArgument(idx + 1).getType();
    if (argType != inputType)
      return emitOpError("staging body argument #")
             << (idx + 1) << " has type " << argType << ", expected "
             << inputType;
  }

  DeviceGraphStagingYieldOp yieldOp = getYieldOp();
  if (yieldOp.getNumOperands() != getNumResults())
    return emitOpError("`mgp.device_graph.staging.yield` has ")
           << yieldOp.getNumOperands() << " operand(s), expected "
           << getNumResults();
  for (auto [idx, resultType] :
       llvm::enumerate(getStagedResults().getTypes())) {
    Type operandType = yieldOp.getOperand(idx).getType();
    if (operandType != resultType)
      return emitOpError("`mgp.device_graph.staging.yield` operand #")
             << idx << " has type " << operandType << ", expected "
             << resultType;
  }
  return success();
}

void DeviceGraphStagingOp::build(
    OpBuilder &builder, OperationState &result, ValueRange inputs,
    llvm::function_ref<void(OpBuilder &, Location, Value, ValueRange)>
        bodyBuilder) {
  OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(builder);

  result.addOperands(inputs);

  // The callback populates the body and is expected to emit the staging.yield.
  Region *bodyRegion = result.addRegion();
  Block *body = builder.createBlock(bodyRegion);
  Value graphBuilder = body->addArgument(
      DeviceGraphBuilderType::get(builder.getContext()), result.location);
  SmallVector<Value> inputArgs;
  inputArgs.reserve(inputs.size());
  for (Value input : inputs)
    inputArgs.push_back(body->addArgument(input.getType(), result.location));
  if (bodyBuilder)
    bodyBuilder(builder, result.location, graphBuilder, inputArgs);

  // Supply the operandless terminator (zero staged results) if the callback did
  // not emit one.
  if (!body->mightHaveTerminator())
    ensureTerminator(*bodyRegion, builder, result.location);

  auto yieldOp = cast<DeviceGraphStagingYieldOp>(body->getTerminator());
  result.addTypes(yieldOp.getOperandTypes());
}

namespace {

/// Drops unused results of an `mgp.device_graph.staging` op and the matching
/// yield operands.
struct RemoveUnusedStagingResults
    : public OpRewritePattern<DeviceGraphStagingOp> {
  using OpRewritePattern::OpRewritePattern;

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(DeviceGraphStagingOp op,
                                PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    SmallVector<unsigned> usedResultIndices;
    SmallVector<Type> usedResultTypes;
    for (auto [idx, result] : llvm::enumerate(op.getResults())) {
      if (!result.use_empty()) {
        usedResultIndices.push_back(idx);
        usedResultTypes.push_back(result.getType());
      }
    }

    if (usedResultIndices.size() == op.getNumResults())
      return failure();

    DeviceGraphStagingYieldOp oldYield = op.getYieldOp();
    auto newYieldOperands =
        llvm::map_to_vector(usedResultIndices, [&](unsigned idx) -> Value {
          return oldYield.getOperand(idx);
        });

    auto newOp = DeviceGraphStagingOp::create(
        rewriter, op.getLoc(), TypeRange(usedResultTypes), op.getInputs(),
        op.getConstantResources());

    newOp.getBody().takeBody(op.getBody());
    DeviceGraphStagingYieldOp newYield = newOp.getYieldOp();
    rewriter.modifyOpInPlace(newYield, [&]() {
      newYield.getOperandsMutable().assign(newYieldOperands);
    });

    SmallVector<Value> replacements(op.getNumResults());
    for (auto [newIdx, oldIdx] : llvm::enumerate(usedResultIndices))
      replacements[oldIdx] = newOp.getResult(newIdx);
    rewriter.replaceOp(op, replacements);
    return success();
  }
};

/// De-duplicates results of an `mgp.device_graph.staging` op whose yield
/// carries the same value more than once.
struct DeduplicateStagingResults
    : public OpRewritePattern<DeviceGraphStagingOp> {
  using OpRewritePattern::OpRewritePattern;

  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(DeviceGraphStagingOp op,
                                PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
    DeviceGraphStagingYieldOp oldYield = op.getYieldOp();

    llvm::SmallDenseMap<Value, unsigned> firstOccurrence;
    SmallVector<Value> dedupedOperands;
    SmallVector<Type> dedupedTypes;
    SmallVector<unsigned> resultRemap(op.getNumResults());
    for (auto [idx, operand] : llvm::enumerate(oldYield.getOperands())) {
      auto [it, inserted] =
          firstOccurrence.try_emplace(operand, dedupedOperands.size());
      if (inserted) {
        dedupedOperands.push_back(operand);
        dedupedTypes.push_back(op.getResult(idx).getType());
      }
      resultRemap[idx] = it->second;
    }

    if (dedupedOperands.size() == op.getNumResults())
      return failure();

    auto newOp = DeviceGraphStagingOp::create(
        rewriter, op.getLoc(), TypeRange(dedupedTypes), op.getInputs(),
        op.getConstantResources());

    newOp.getBody().takeBody(op.getBody());
    DeviceGraphStagingYieldOp newYield = newOp.getYieldOp();
    rewriter.modifyOpInPlace(newYield, [&]() {
      newYield.getOperandsMutable().assign(dedupedOperands);
    });

    SmallVector<Value> replacements =
        llvm::map_to_vector(resultRemap, [&](unsigned newIdx) -> Value {
          return newOp.getResult(newIdx);
        });
    rewriter.replaceOp(op, replacements);
    return success();
  }
};

} // namespace

void DeviceGraphStagingOp::getCanonicalizationPatterns(
    RewritePatternSet &patterns, MLIRContext *ctx) {
  patterns.add<RemoveUnusedStagingResults, DeduplicateStagingResults>(ctx);
}
