//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// AssertOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

bool AssertOp::isThrows() { return true; }

LogicalResult AssertOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  auto primDecl = state.registry.lookupPrimitive(getOperationName());
  MOGG::MojoValue function(primitiveMojoName(primDecl));

  MOGG::MojoValue conditionVar = state.getMojoValueFor(getCond());
  MOGG::MojoValue messageLiteral = MOGG::MojoValue(getMessage()).quote();
  MOGG::MojoValue messageString = state.builder.var(
      MOGG::MojoValue(MOGG::kStructString)({}, {messageLiteral}));
  MOGG::MojoStringRef message(messageString);
  MOGG::MojoValue messagePtr = message.unsafePtr();
  MOGG::MojoValue messageSize = message.byteLength();

  state.builder.call(function, {}, {conditionVar, messagePtr, messageSize});

  return success();
}

SmallVector<Attribute> AssertOp::getLiftableAttributes() {
  return {getMessageAttr()};
}

LogicalResult AssertOp::canonicalize(AssertOp op, PatternRewriter &rewriter) {
  bool isInKernel = false;
  if (op->getParentOfType<MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp>())
    isInKernel = true;

  if (op->getParentOfType<MOGG::FuncOp>())
    isInKernel = true;

  BoolAttr condAttr;
  if (mlir::matchPattern(op.getCond(), mlir::m_Constant(&condAttr))) {
    if (condAttr.getValue()) {
      if (isInKernel) {
        rewriter.replaceOpWithNewOp<MOGG::ChainDummyOp>(op);
      } else {
        rewriter.replaceOpWithNewOp<GRT::ChainCreateOp>(op);
      }
      return success();
    }
  }
  return failure();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorExtractBufferOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
LogicalResult TensorExtractBufferOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  using namespace MOGG;

  auto primDecl = state.registry.lookupPrimitive(getOperationName());
  MojoValue function(primitiveMojoName(primDecl));

  MojoValue res =
      state.builder.var(function({}, state.getMojoValueFor(getTensor())));
  state.setMojoValueFor(getOutBuffer(), res);

  return success();
}

LogicalResult TensorExtractBufferOp::verify() {
  DeviceBufferType expectedBufferType =
      DeviceBufferType::get(getTensor().getType());
  if (expectedBufferType != getOutBuffer().getType()) {
    return emitOpError("expected the result buffer to match the type "
                       "implied by the tensor type (")
           << getOutBuffer().getType() << " vs " << expectedBufferType << ").";
  }
  return success();
}

LogicalResult TensorExtractBufferOp::inferReturnTypes(
    MLIRContext *context, std::optional<Location> location, Adaptor adaptor,
    SmallVectorImpl<Type> &inferredReturnTypes) {
  auto tensorType = dyn_cast<DeviceTensorType>(adaptor.getTensor().getType());
  if (!tensorType) {
    return mlir::emitError(location.value_or(adaptor.getTensor().getLoc()),
                           "expected tensor operand.");
  }
  inferredReturnTypes.emplace_back(DeviceBufferType::get(tensorType));
  return success();
}

bool TensorExtractBufferOp::mayAlias(size_t operandIndex, size_t resultIndex) {
  return operandIndex == getTensorMutable().getOperandNumber();
}

OpFoldResult TensorExtractBufferOp::fold(FoldAdaptor adaptor) {
  Operation *tensorProducer = getTensor().getDefiningOp();
  if (auto create = dyn_cast_or_null<TensorCreateOp>(tensorProducer))
    return create.getBuffer();

  return {};
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorExtractTensorSpecOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
LogicalResult TensorExtractTensorSpecOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  using namespace MOGG;

  auto primDecl = state.registry.lookupPrimitive(getOperationName());
  MojoValue function(primitiveMojoName(primDecl));

  DeviceTensorType tensorType = getTensor().getType();
  MojoValue tensorRankParam = tensorType.getRank();
  MojoValue bufferRankParam =
      tensorType.getRank() == 0 ? MojoValue{1} : tensorRankParam;
  auto tensorSpec = tensorType.getTensorSpec();
  MojoValue tensorDtypeParam =
      state.mlirDTypeToMojoType(tensorSpec.getOptDType().value());

  MojoValue result = state.builder.var(
      function({tensorRankParam, bufferRankParam, tensorDtypeParam},
               state.getMojoValueFor(getTensor())));
  state.setMojoValueFor(getResult(), result);
  return success();
}

LogicalResult TensorExtractTensorSpecOp::verify() {
  TensorSpecType expectedSpecType = getTensor().getType().getTensorSpec();
  if (expectedSpecType != getOutSpec().getType()) {
    return emitOpError("expected the result tensor spec to match the type "
                       "implied by the tensor type (")
           << getOutSpec().getType() << " vs " << expectedSpecType << ").";
  }
  if (!expectedSpecType.getOptDType().has_value())
    return emitError() << "Expected to have DType information for operand";
  return success();
}

LogicalResult TensorExtractTensorSpecOp::inferReturnTypes(
    MLIRContext *context, std::optional<Location> location, Adaptor adaptor,
    SmallVectorImpl<Type> &inferredReturnTypes) {
  auto tensorType = dyn_cast<DeviceTensorType>(adaptor.getTensor().getType());
  if (!tensorType) {
    return mlir::emitError(location.value_or(adaptor.getTensor().getLoc()),
                           "expected tensor operand.");
  }
  inferredReturnTypes.emplace_back(tensorType.getTensorSpec());
  return success();
}

OpFoldResult TensorExtractTensorSpecOp::fold(FoldAdaptor adaptor) {
  Operation *tensorProducer = getTensor().getDefiningOp();
  if (auto create = dyn_cast_or_null<TensorCreateOp>(tensorProducer))
    return create.getTensorSpec();
  return {};
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// GuardOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

LogicalResult GuardOp::verify() {
  if (getInputs().size() != getResults().size()) {
    return emitError() << "Expected the number of inputs and outputs to be "
                          "exactly the same";
  }
  return success();
}

LogicalResult
GuardOp::inferReturnTypes(MLIRContext *context,
                          std::optional<Location> location, Adaptor adaptor,
                          SmallVectorImpl<Type> &inferredReturnTypes) {
  TypeRange inputTypes = adaptor.getInputs().getTypes();
  inferredReturnTypes.append(inputTypes.begin(), inputTypes.end());
  return success();
}

bool GuardOp::mayAlias(size_t operandIndex, size_t resultIndex) { return true; }

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorCreateOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

LogicalResult TensorCreateOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  using namespace MOGG;

  auto primDecl = state.registry.lookupPrimitive(getOperationName());
  MojoValue function(primitiveMojoName(primDecl));

  DeviceTensorType tensorType = getOutTensor().getType();
  MojoValue tensorRankParam = tensorType.getRank();
  MojoValue bufferRankParam =
      tensorType.getRank() == 0 ? MojoValue{1} : tensorRankParam;
  auto tensorSpec = tensorType.getTensorSpec();
  MojoValue tensorDtypeParam =
      state.mlirDTypeToMojoType(tensorSpec.getOptDType().value());

  SmallVector<MojoValue> params = {tensorRankParam, bufferRankParam,
                                   tensorDtypeParam};
  // `kind` names how the tensor participates as a device graph input; the
  // Mojo default (`data`) is left implicit.
  if (tensorType.getMut())
    params.push_back(MojoValue(MOGG::kParameterKind)
                         .equal(MojoValue(MOGG::kStructDeviceGraphInputKind)
                                    .get(MOGG::kInputKindMutable)));
  else if (M::isHostPlaced(tensorType.getDevice()))
    params.push_back(MojoValue(MOGG::kParameterKind)
                         .equal(MojoValue(MOGG::kStructDeviceGraphInputKind)
                                    .get(MOGG::kInputKindHost)));

  MojoValue result = state.builder.var(
      function(params, state.getMojoValuesFor(getOperands().drop_front())));
  state.setMojoValueFor(getOutTensor(), result);

  return success();
}

bool TensorCreateOp::extendsLifetime(size_t operandIndex, size_t resultIndex) {
  return operandIndex == getBufferMutable().getOperandNumber();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorSliceOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

bool TensorSliceOp::isThrows() { return true; }

LogicalResult TensorSliceOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  using namespace MOGG;

  auto primDecl = state.registry.lookupPrimitive(getOperationName());
  MojoValue function(primitiveMojoName(primDecl));

  DeviceTensorType inputType = getInput().getType();
  MojoValue rankParam = inputType.getRank();
  auto tensorSpec = inputType.getTensorSpec();
  MojoValue dtypeParam =
      state.mlirDTypeToMojoType(tensorSpec.getOptDType().value());

  // input, outputSpec, and start are all runtime operands.
  MojoValue result = state.builder.var(
      function({rankParam, dtypeParam}, state.getMojoValuesFor(getOperands())));
  state.setMojoValueFor(getOutput(), result);

  return success();
}

LogicalResult TensorSliceOp::inferReturnTypes(
    MLIRContext *context, std::optional<Location> location, Adaptor adaptor,
    SmallVectorImpl<Type> &inferredReturnTypes) {
  auto inputType = dyn_cast<DeviceTensorType>(adaptor.getInput().getType());
  if (!inputType)
    return mlir::emitError(location.value_or(UnknownLoc::get(context)),
                           "expected tensor operand");
  auto specType = dyn_cast<TensorSpecType>(adaptor.getOutputSpec().getType());
  if (!specType)
    return mlir::emitError(location.value_or(UnknownLoc::get(context)),
                           "expected tensor spec operand");
  inferredReturnTypes.emplace_back(
      DeviceTensorType::get(context, inputType.getDevice(), specType,
                            inputType.getMut(), inputType.getStable()));
  return success();
}

LogicalResult TensorSliceOp::verify() {
  DeviceTensorType inputType = getInput().getType();
  TensorSpecType specType = getOutputSpec().getType();
  if (inputType.getTensorSpec().getOptDType() != specType.getOptDType())
    return emitOpError("input and output dtypes must match");
  DeviceTensorType startType = getStart().getType();
  if (startType.getDevice().getLabel() != kCPULabel)
    return emitOpError("start must be on the host (cpu) device");
  if (getDeviceContext().getType().getDevice() != inputType.getDevice())
    return emitOpError(
        "device context must be on the same device as the input");
  return success();
}

bool TensorSliceOp::extendsLifetime(size_t operandIndex, size_t resultIndex) {
  return operandIndex == getInputMutable().getOperandNumber();
}

bool TensorSliceOp::mayAlias(size_t operandIndex, size_t resultIndex) {
  return operandIndex == getInputMutable().getOperandNumber();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorExtractBufferOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

bool TensorExtractBufferOp::extendsLifetime(size_t operandIndex,
                                            size_t resultIndex) {
  return operandIndex == getTensorMutable().getOperandNumber();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// CallOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

LogicalResult
CallOp::verifySymbolUses(mlir::SymbolTableCollection &symbolTable) {
  auto targetModel =
      symbolTable.lookupNearestSymbolFrom<ModelOp>(*this, getCalleeAttr());
  if (!targetModel)
    return emitOpError() << "failed to find symbol " << getCalleeAttr();

  Block *executeBlock = targetModel.getExecuteBlock();
  // Until the index is globalized, the execute block's last arg is the index.
  auto expectedArgs =
      executeBlock->getArguments().drop_back(!getIsGlobalizedIndex());
  auto actualArgTypes = getOperandTypes();
  if (expectedArgs.size() != actualArgTypes.size()) {
    return emitOpError() << "operand types " << actualArgTypes
                         << " do not match expected argument types "
                         << executeBlock->getArgumentTypes() << " of "
                         << getCalleeAttr() << "'s execute block.";
  }

  for (auto [expectedArg, actualArgType] :
       llvm::zip(expectedArgs, actualArgTypes)) {
    if (expectedArg.getType() != actualArgType) {
      return emitOpError() << "operand types " << actualArgTypes
                           << " do not match expected argument types "
                           << executeBlock->getArgumentTypes() << " of "
                           << getCalleeAttr() << "'s execute block.";
    }
  }

  auto outputOp = dyn_cast<MEF::OutputOp>(executeBlock->getTerminator());
  if (!outputOp) {
    return emitOpError() << "execute block of " << getCalleeAttr()
                         << " does not end with an mef.output op.";
  }

  auto expectedResultTypes = outputOp.getOperandTypes();
  auto actualResultTypes = getResultTypes();
  if (actualResultTypes != expectedResultTypes) {
    return emitOpError() << "result types " << actualResultTypes
                         << " do not match expected result types "
                         << expectedResultTypes << " of " << getCalleeAttr()
                         << "'s execute block.";
  }

  return success();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// DebugPrintOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

bool DebugPrintOp::isThrows() { return true; }

LogicalResult DebugPrintOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  auto primDecl = state.registry.lookupPrimitive(getOperationName());
  MOGG::MojoValue function(primitiveMojoName(primDecl));

  MOGG::MojoValue debugStringParam = MOGG::MojoValue(getDebugString()).quote();
  MOGG::MojoValue labelParam = MOGG::MojoValue(getLabel()).quote();
  MOGG::MojoValue ctxVar = state.getMojoValueFor(getTheContext());

  state.builder.call(function, {debugStringParam, labelParam}, ctxVar);

  return success();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// DebugPrintIntOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

LogicalResult DebugPrintIntOp::emitMojo(MOGG::EmitMojoState &state) {
  auto primDecl = state.registry.lookupPrimitive(getOperationName());
  MOGG::MojoValue function(primitiveMojoName(primDecl));

  MOGG::MojoValue labelParam = MOGG::MojoValue(getALabel()).quote();
  MOGG::MojoValue ctxVar = state.getMojoValueFor(getTheContext());
  MOGG::MojoValue valueVar = state.getMojoValueFor(getValue());

  state.builder.call(function, {labelParam}, {ctxVar, valueVar});

  return success();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// ModelOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

// Builds an !mgp.opaque type with the given symbol name.
static OpaqueType opaqueType(MLIRContext *ctx, StringRef symbol) {
  return OpaqueType::get(ctx, StringAttr::get(ctx, symbol),
                         /*metadata=*/{});
}

// Extends args with the weights registry and device context implicit args.
static void appendInitExecImplicitArgs(SmallVectorImpl<Type> &args,
                                       MLIRContext *ctx,
                                       ArrayRef<DeviceRef> devices) {
  args.push_back(opaqueType(ctx, "weights_registry"));

  for (const DeviceRef &device : devices) {
    args.push_back(DeviceContextType::get(
        ctx, DeviceRefAttr::get(ctx, device.label, device.id)));
  }
}

/// Returns the implicit signature of the 'init' entry point.
static FunctionType implicitInitSignature(Builder &builder,
                                          ArrayRef<DeviceRef> devices) {
  SmallVector<Type> inputs;
  appendInitExecImplicitArgs(inputs, builder.getContext(), devices);

  SmallVector<Type> outputs = {builder.getType<MEF::ChainType>(),
                               builder.getType<MGP::ContextType>()};
  appendInitExecImplicitArgs(outputs, builder.getContext(), devices);

  return builder.getFunctionType(inputs, outputs);
}

/// Returns the implicit signature of the 'execute' entry point, before
/// any explicit inputs and results have been included.
static FunctionType implicitExecuteSignature(Builder &builder,
                                             ArrayRef<DeviceRef> devices) {
  SmallVector<Type> inputs = {builder.getType<MEF::ChainType>(),
                              builder.getType<MGP::ContextType>()};

  appendInitExecImplicitArgs(inputs, builder.getContext(), devices);

  return builder.getFunctionType(
      inputs, /*results=*/{builder.getType<MEF::ChainType>()});
}

/// Returns true if requiredTypes is a prefix of actualTypes, in which case
/// the prefix is removed from actualTypes.
static bool checkAndRemovePrefix(ArrayRef<Type> requiredTypes,
                                 SmallVectorImpl<Type> &actualTypes) {
  auto [mismatchRequired, mismatchActual] = std::mismatch(
      requiredTypes.begin(), requiredTypes.end(), actualTypes.begin());
  if (mismatchRequired != requiredTypes.end())
    return false;
  actualTypes.erase(actualTypes.begin(),
                    actualTypes.begin() + requiredTypes.size());
  return true;
}

/// Parse an optional symbol visibility keyword, mirroring
/// `function_interface_impl::parseFunctionOp`.
static ParseResult parseSymbolVisibility(OpAsmParser &p,
                                         StringAttr &visibility) {
  StringRef keyword;
  if (succeeded(
          p.parseOptionalKeyword(&keyword, {"public", "private", "nested"})))
    visibility = p.getBuilder().getStringAttr(keyword);
  return success();
}

/// Prints the symbol visibility keyword, if present.
static void printSymbolVisibility(OpAsmPrinter &p, Operation *op,
                                  StringAttr visibility) {
  if (visibility)
    p << visibility.getValue() << ' ';
}

/// Parse the frameworkName attribute as a keyword.
static ParseResult parseClassName(OpAsmParser &p, StringAttr &frameworkName) {
  StringRef keyword;
  if (p.parseKeyword(&keyword))
    return failure();
  frameworkName = StringAttr::get(p.getContext(), keyword);
  return success();
}

/// Prints the frameworkName attribute as a keyword.
static void printClassName(OpAsmPrinter &p, const ModelOp &op,
                           StringAttr frameworkName) {
  p << frameworkName.getValue();
}

/// Parse the init region.
static ParseResult parseInitRegion(OpAsmParser &p, Region &initRegion) {
  llvm::SMLoc argLoc;
  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::Argument> args;
  SmallVector<Type> outputTypes;
  if (p.getCurrentLocation(&argLoc) ||
      p.parseArgumentList(args, OpAsmParser::Delimiter::Paren,
                          /*allowType=*/true) ||
      p.parseRegion(initRegion, args, /*enableNameShadowing=*/true))
    return failure();

  return success();
}

/// Print the init region.
static void printInitRegion(OpAsmPrinter &p, const ModelOp &op,
                            Region &initRegion) {
  Block &initBlock = initRegion.front();
  p << "(";
  llvm::interleaveComma(initBlock.getArguments(), p.getStream(),
                        [&](auto arg) { p.printRegionArgument(arg); });
  p << ") ";
  p.printRegion(initRegion, /*printEntryBlockArgs=*/false);
}

/// Parses the 'execute' body, and extracts from it the implicit signature.
static ParseResult parseExecuteRegion(OpAsmParser &p,
                                      TypeAttr &inputOutputTypes,
                                      Region &executeRegion,
                                      ArrayAttr &deviceAttrs) {
  llvm::SMLoc argLoc;
  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::Argument> args;
  SmallVector<Type> outputTypes;
  if (p.getCurrentLocation(&argLoc) ||
      p.parseArgumentList(args, OpAsmParser::Delimiter::Paren,
                          /*allowType=*/true) ||
      p.parseArrowTypeList(outputTypes) ||
      p.parseRegion(executeRegion, args, /*enableNameShadowing=*/true))
    return failure();

  // Strip the implicit prefix; the rest becomes inputOutputTypes.
  SmallVector<DeviceRef> devices;
  for (auto attr : deviceAttrs) {
    if (auto deviceAttr = dyn_cast<DeviceRefAttr>(attr))
      devices.emplace_back(
          DeviceRef(deviceAttr.getLabel().str(), deviceAttr.getId()));
  }
  FunctionType implicitExecSig =
      implicitExecuteSignature(p.getBuilder(), devices);
  SmallVector<Type> inputTypes(executeRegion.getArgumentTypes());
  if (!checkAndRemovePrefix(implicitExecSig.getInputs(), inputTypes))
    return p.emitError(argLoc)
           << "expected the 'execute' region arguments to begin with types "
           << implicitExecSig.getInputs() << ".";
  if (!checkAndRemovePrefix(implicitExecSig.getResults(), outputTypes))
    return p.emitError(argLoc)
           << "expected the 'execute' region outputs to begin with types "
           << implicitExecSig.getResults() << ".";

  inputOutputTypes =
      TypeAttr::get(p.getBuilder().getFunctionType(inputTypes, outputTypes));
  return success();
}

/// Prints the 'execute' body. The inputOutputTypes are ignored.
static void printExecuteRegion(OpAsmPrinter &p, const ModelOp &op,
                               TypeAttr inputOutputTypes, Region &executeRegion,
                               ArrayAttr devices) {
  Block &executeBlock = executeRegion.front();
  p << "(";
  llvm::interleaveComma(executeBlock.getArguments(), p.getStream(),
                        [&](auto arg) { p.printRegionArgument(arg); });
  p << ")";
  p.printArrowTypeList(executeBlock.getTerminator()->getOperandTypes());
  p << " ";
  p.printRegion(executeRegion, /*printEntryBlockArgs=*/false);
}

void ModelOp::build(OpBuilder &builder, OperationState &state, StringAttr name,
                    StringRef frameworkName, ArrayRef<DeviceRef> devices,
                    ArrayRef<Type> inputTypes, ArrayRef<Type> outputTypes,
                    ArrayRef<Location> inputArgLocs, bool isSubgraph,
                    bool isDeviceGraph, ArrayRef<NamedAttribute> extraAttrs) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = state.getContext();

  SmallVector<Type> finalInputTypes(inputTypes.begin(), inputTypes.end());
  SmallVector<Location> finalInputLocs(inputArgLocs.begin(),
                                       inputArgLocs.end());
  if (isSubgraph) {
    state.addAttribute(getIsSubgraphAttrName(state.name), UnitAttr::get(ctx));
    finalInputTypes.push_back(IndexType::get(ctx));
    finalInputLocs.push_back(state.location);
  }

  DictionaryAttr extraAttrsDict =
      extraAttrs.empty() ? nullptr : DictionaryAttr::get(ctx, extraAttrs);
  auto deviceAttrs = llvm::map_to_vector(devices, [ctx](const DeviceRef &ref) {
    return dyn_cast<Attribute>(DeviceRefAttr::get(ctx, ref.label, ref.id));
  });
  build(builder, state, ArrayAttr::get(ctx, deviceAttrs),
        StringAttr::get(ctx, frameworkName),
        TypeAttr::get(builder.getFunctionType(finalInputTypes, outputTypes)),
        name, /*sym_visibility=*/nullptr,
        isSubgraph ? builder.getUnitAttr() : nullptr,
        isDeviceGraph ? builder.getUnitAttr() : nullptr, extraAttrsDict);

  Region *initRegion = state.regions[0].get();
  initRegion->emplaceBlock();

  for (auto type : implicitInitSignature(builder, devices).getInputs())
    initRegion->addArgument(type, state.location);

  // The 'execute' entry point has both implicit and explicit arguments.
  Region *executeRegion = state.regions[1].get();
  executeRegion->emplaceBlock();
  for (auto type : implicitExecuteSignature(builder, devices).getInputs())
    executeRegion->addArgument(type, state.location);
  for (auto [type, loc] : llvm::zip(finalInputTypes, finalInputLocs))
    executeRegion->addArgument(type, loc);
}

/// Verifies the init and execute regions of the model.
LogicalResult ModelOp::verifyRegions() {
  using BlockArgTypeRange = mlir::ValueTypeRange<mlir::Block::BlockArgListType>;

  Builder builder(getContext());

  SmallVector<DeviceRef> devices;
  for (auto attr : getDevices()) {
    if (auto deviceAttr = dyn_cast<DeviceRefAttr>(attr))
      devices.emplace_back(
          DeviceRef(deviceAttr.getLabel().str(), deviceAttr.getId()));
  }

  // The type of the init region is
  //  () -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.context)
  Block *initBlock = getInitBlock();
  BlockArgTypeRange initArgTypes = initBlock->getArgumentTypes();
  if (auto output = dyn_cast<MEF::OutputOp>(initBlock->getTerminator())) {
    FunctionType implicitInitSig = implicitInitSignature(builder, devices);

    // One arg per device plus the weights registry.
    size_t numDeviceArgs = initArgTypes.size() - 1;
    if (numDeviceArgs != getDevices().size()) {
      return emitOpError() << "Expected the number of arguments to the 'init' "
                              "body to match the number of devices, but got "
                           << numDeviceArgs << " vs " << getDevices().size()
                           << ".";
    }
    for (auto t : initArgTypes) {
      if (!mlir::isa<OpaqueType, DeviceContextType>(t)) {
        return emitOpError() << "init block arguments must be !mgp.opaque or "
                                "!mgp.device_context, but got "
                             << t;
      }
    }

    int contextCreateOpCount = 0;
    initBlock->walk([&](ContextCreateOp) { contextCreateOpCount++; });
    if (contextCreateOpCount != 1) {
      return emitOpError()
             << "expected exactly one mgp.context_create op in the "
                "'init' block, but found "
             << contextCreateOpCount;
    }

    if (failed(checkOperandTypes(output, implicitInitSig.getResults())))
      return failure();
  }

  // The type of the execute region is:
  //   (!mef.chain, !mgp.context, weights_registry, dev_1, ..., dev_n, arg_1,
  //   ... arg_n) ->
  //   (!mef.chain, res_1, ... res_m)
  // where the ModelOp's inputOutputTypes are:
  //   (arg_1, ... arg_n) -> (res_1, ... res_m)
  Block *execBlock = getExecuteBlock();
  if (auto output = dyn_cast<MEF::OutputOp>(execBlock->getTerminator())) {
    FunctionType implicitExecSig = implicitExecuteSignature(builder, devices);
    ArrayRef<Type> modelArgTypes = getInputOutputTypes().getInputs();
    SmallVector<Type> expectedArgTypes(implicitExecSig.getInputs());
    expectedArgTypes.append(modelArgTypes.begin(), modelArgTypes.end());
    if (execBlock->getArgumentTypes() != expectedArgTypes) {
      return emitOpError() << "expected the arguments of the "
                              "'execute' body to be "
                           << expectedArgTypes << ", but got "
                           << execBlock->getArgumentTypes() << ".";
    }

    ArrayRef<Type> modelResultTypes = getInputOutputTypes().getResults();
    SmallVector<Type> expectedResultTypes(implicitExecSig.getResults());
    expectedResultTypes.append(modelResultTypes.begin(),
                               modelResultTypes.end());

    if (failed(checkOperandTypes(output, expectedResultTypes)))
      return failure();
  }

  if (getIsSubgraph()) {
    auto argTypes = execBlock->getArgumentTypes();
    if (argTypes.empty() ||
        !isa<IndexType>(*(argTypes.begin() + argTypes.size() - 1))) {
      return emitOpError() << "expected the last argument of a subgraph to be "
                              "an index offset";
    }
  }

  return success();
}

LogicalResult ModelOp::verify() { return success(); }

ContextCreateOp ModelOp::getInitContext() {
  auto range = getInitBlock()->getOps<ContextCreateOp>();
  ASSERT_STREAM(llvm::hasSingleElement(range),
                "should contain one context create op");
  return *std::begin(range);
}

TypedValue<ContextType> ModelOp::getExecuteContext() {
  auto argument = getExecuteBlock()->getArgument(1);
  return cast<TypedValue<ContextType>>(argument);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// DeferAllocsPass
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Defers buffer allocations until their writers are ready to execute.
class DeferAllocsPass : public impl::DeferAllocsPassBase<DeferAllocsPass> {
  void runOnOperation() override {
    ModelOp model = getOperation();
    ExecuteState execState(model.getContext(), model);
    BufferBuilderContext builderContext =
        TensorBufferDialectInterface::getAllBufferBuilders(model);

    // Guards against revisiting allocs when an op writes multiple buffers.
    DenseSet<Operation *> movedAllocOps;

    auto defer = [&](Operation *op) {
      if (movedAllocOps.contains(op))
        return;

      auto allocOp = dyn_cast<MGPBufferAllocOpInterface>(op);
      if (!allocOp)
        return;

      OpOperand *mutator = getUniqueMutator(allocOp.getOutBuffer());
      if (!mutator)
        return;

      allocOp->moveBefore(mutator->getOwner());
      movedAllocOps.insert(allocOp);

      SmallVector<Value> additionalChainsToWaitOn;
      for (OpOperand *mutatorChainOpOperand :
           getInputChainOpOperands(mutator->getOwner())) {
        additionalChainsToWaitOn.push_back(mutatorChainOpOperand->get());
      }

      execState.builder.setInsertionPoint(allocOp);
      [[maybe_unused]] auto res = alsoWaitForChains(
          execState.builder, builderContext, allocOp, additionalChainsToWaitOn);
      ASSERT_STREAM(succeeded(res),
                    << "all allocation ops must accept an input "
                       "chain to control their timing");
    };

    model.getExecute().walk(defer);
    model.getInit().walk(defer);
  }
};

} // namespace
} // namespace M::MGP

#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Transforms/MGPTransforms.h"

#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Dialect/MGPBufferLifetimeAnalysis.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Dialect/MGPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Transforms/Utils.h"
#include "Mojo/POPDialect/POPDialect.h"
#include "Support/AssertStream.h"
#include "mlir/Dialect/Index/IR/IndexDialect.h"
#include "mlir/Dialect/Index/IR/IndexOps.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/STLExtras.h"
#include "llvm/Support/Debug.h"
#include <numeric>

#define DEBUG_TYPE "mgp-dynamic-memory-planning"

using namespace mlir;

namespace M::MGP {

// Generate support code for DynamicMemoryPlanningPass
#define GEN_PASS_DEF_DYNAMICMEMORYPLANNINGPASS
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Transforms/MGPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

struct AllocInfo {
  MGP::BufferAllocOp alloc;
  Value runtimeSize;
  uint64_t alignment;
  SmallVector<Operation *> uses;
};

/// Returns true if `v` is computable from block arguments by arithmetic and
/// tensor_spec ops alone, i.e. an allocation size that is not data-dependent.
/// Results are cached per producing op in `trivial`.
bool isTriviallyComputable(Value v, DenseMap<Operation *, bool> &trivial) {
  Operation *producer = v.getDefiningOp();

  if (!producer)
    return true;

  if (auto it = trivial.find(producer); it != trivial.end())
    return it->second;

  auto cacheResult = [&](bool result) -> bool {
    trivial[producer] = result;
    return result;
  };

  bool isTrivialOp = producer->hasTrait<OpTrait::ConstantLike>() ||
                     isa<KGEN::POP::POPDialect>(*producer->getDialect()) ||
                     isa<mlir::index::IndexDialect>(*producer->getDialect()) ||
                     isa<TensorExtractTensorSpecOp, TensorSpecCreateOp,
                         BufferAllocOp, TensorSpecGetDimOp>(*producer);
  if (!isTrivialOp)
    return cacheResult(false);

  auto trivialOperands =
      llvm::all_of(producer->getOperands(), [&](Value operand) {
        return isTriviallyComputable(operand, trivial);
      });

  return cacheResult(trivialOperands);
}

} // end namespace

class DynamicMemoryPlanningPass
    : public impl::DynamicMemoryPlanningPassBase<DynamicMemoryPlanningPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    ModelOp modelOp = getOperation();

    auto getDeviceContext = [&modelOp](DeviceRefAttr dev,
                                       ArrayRef<BlockArgument> devices) {
      for (auto [deviceRefAttr, deviceContext] :
           llvm::zip_equal(modelOp.getDevices(), devices))
        if (deviceRefAttr == dev)
          return std::optional<Value>(deviceContext);
      return std::optional<Value>();
    };

    auto &analysis = getAnalysis<BufferLifetimeAnalysisPass>();

    BufferBuilderContext builderContext =
        TensorBufferDialectInterface::getAllBufferBuilders(modelOp);

    ExecuteState execState(modelOp->getContext(), modelOp);
    OpBuilder &execBuilder = execState.builder;

    DependencyTree &tree = analysis.getDepTree(execState.execute);

    llvm::MapVector<DeviceRefAttr, SmallVector<AllocInfo>> deviceToAllocs;

    DenseMap<Operation *, bool> trivialVals;

    for (auto allocOp : execState.execute->getOps<MGP::BufferAllocOp>()) {
      // TODO(GEX-557): Plan CPU allocations too.
      if (allocOp.getDevice().getLabel() == kCPULabel)
        continue;

      ErrorOr<SmallVector<Operation *>> allocUses = getAllocUses(allocOp);

      if (allocUses.isError() || allocUses->empty())
        continue;

      if (!isTriviallyComputable(allocOp.getRuntimeSize(), trivialVals))
        continue;

      SmallVector<Operation *> uses;
      bool ineligibleAlloc = false;
      for (auto *use : allocUses.get()) {
        if (!tree.contains(use)) {
          ineligibleAlloc = true;
          break;
        }
        uses.push_back(use);
      }

      if (ineligibleAlloc)
        continue;

      SmallVector<AllocInfo> &allocs = deviceToAllocs[allocOp.getDevice()];
      allocs.push_back({allocOp, allocOp.getRuntimeSize(),
                        allocOp.getRawAlign(), std::move(uses)});
    }

    // At the block start, for readability.
    execBuilder.setInsertionPointToStart(modelOp.getExecuteBlock());

    SmallVector<BufferAllocOp> allocsToDelete;
    for (auto &[device, allocs] : deviceToAllocs) {
      if (allocs.size() <= 1)
        continue;

      // Plan allocations needed sooner first.
      auto firstTopoIndex = [&](const AllocInfo &info) {
        unsigned minIdx = std::numeric_limits<unsigned>::max();
        for (Operation *use : info.uses)
          minIdx = std::min(minIdx, tree.getTopoIndex(use));
        return minIdx;
      };
      llvm::sort(allocs, [&](const auto &a, const auto &b) {
        return firstTopoIndex(a) < firstTopoIndex(b);
      });

      SmallVector<uint64_t> alignments;
      SmallVector<Value> runtimeSizes;

      // The pool is aligned to the LCM of all alignments.
      uint64_t totalAlignment = 1;
      for (const AllocInfo &a : allocs) {
        runtimeSizes.push_back(a.runtimeSize);
        alignments.push_back(a.alignment);
        totalAlignment = std::lcm(totalAlignment, a.alignment);
      }

      // canShare[i][j] = 1 iff all uses of i run after all uses of j, or vice
      // versa.
      size_t n = allocs.size();
      SmallVector<uint8_t> canShare(n * n, 0);
      for (size_t i : llvm::seq(n)) {
        for (size_t j : llvm::seq(i + 1, n)) {
          uint8_t sharable =
              (tree.executesAfter(allocs[i].uses, allocs[j].uses) ||
               tree.executesAfter(allocs[j].uses, allocs[i].uses))
                  ? 1
                  : 0;

          canShare[i * n + j] = sharable;
          canShare[j * n + i] = sharable;
        }
      }

      auto locations = llvm::map_to_vector(
          allocs, [](const AllocInfo &alloc) { return alloc.alloc->getLoc(); });

      auto loc = execBuilder.getFusedLoc(locations);
      MGPBufferBuilder &bufferBuilder = builderContext.getBufferBuilder(device);

      std::optional<Value> deviceContext =
          getDeviceContext(device, modelOp.getExecuteDevices());
      ASSERT_STREAM(deviceContext, "Could not find device context for device");

      auto bufferPlanOp = BufferPlanOp::create(execBuilder, loc, runtimeSizes,
                                               alignments, canShare,
                                               /*staticSizes=*/{});

      TypedValue<IndexType> poolSize = bufferPlanOp.getHighWatermark();

      Value alloc = bufferBuilder.bufferAlloc(
          execBuilder, loc, execState.getContext(), execState.getRootChain(),
          poolSize, deviceContext.value(), totalAlignment);

      auto memPoolBuffer = cast<TypedValue<DeviceBufferType>>(alloc);

      // One bulk-slice op rather than N buffer.slice ops: sequence fusion can
      // duplicate each slice op independently (O(N) fan-out).
      SmallVector<Value> offsets(bufferPlanOp.getOffsets().begin(),
                                 bufferPlanOp.getOffsets().end());
      SmallVector<Value> sizes;
      for (const AllocInfo &a : allocs)
        sizes.push_back(a.runtimeSize);

      auto bulkSliceOp =
          BufferBulkSliceOp::create(execBuilder, loc, memPoolBuffer,
                                    deviceContext.value(), offsets, sizes);

      for (size_t i = 0; i < allocs.size(); ++i) {
        allocs[i].alloc->replaceAllUsesWith(
            ValueRange{bulkSliceOp.getOutBuffers()[i]});
        allocsToDelete.push_back(allocs[i].alloc);
      }
    }

    for (BufferAllocOp alloc : allocsToDelete)
      alloc.erase();
  }
};

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_EXECINVARIANTCODEMOTIONPASS
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Transforms/MGPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Predicates
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Returns op's buffer result if op can be lifted into 'init', else null.
static Value getLiftableBufferOp(Operation *op) {
  if (auto liftableOp = dyn_cast<MGPLiftableBufferCreateOpInterface>(op))
    return liftableOp.getOutBuffer();
  return nullptr;
}

static llvm::SmallVector<Value> getLiftableIndexOutputs(Operation *op) {
  llvm::SmallVector<Value> res;
  if (auto kernelOp = dyn_cast<MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp>(op)) {
    for (Value result : op->getResults()) {
      if (result.getType().isIntOrIndex() ||
          MOSH::ShapeAttr::isDimType(result.getType()))
        res.push_back(result);
    }
  }
  return res;
}

static std::pair<TypedValue<MEF::ChainType>, uint64_t>
cacheIntValue(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
              TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
              ContextCreateOp contextCreateOp, Value intValue) {
  intValue = dimensionToIndex(builder, loc, intValue);
  uint64_t intSlot = contextCreateOp.getNumSlots();
  contextCreateOp.setNumSlots(intSlot + 1);

  auto cacheOp = IntCacheOp::create(builder, loc, /*inChain=*/inChain,
                                    /*theContext=*/contextCreateOp,
                                    /*value=*/intValue,
                                    /*bIntSlot=*/intSlot);
  return {cacheOp.getOutChain(), intSlot};
}

static Value getCachedIntValue(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                               TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                               TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                               uint64_t intSlot, Type resultType) {
  auto parentOp = builder.getBlock()->getParentOp();
  if (!isa<ModelOp>(parentOp))
    parentOp = parentOp->getParentOfType<MGP::ModelOp>();

  auto modelOp = cast<ModelOp>(parentOp);
  Value intSlotIndex = mlir::index::ConstantOp::create(builder, loc, intSlot);
  if (modelOp.getIsSubgraph()) {
    intSlotIndex = mlir::index::AddOp::create(builder, loc, intSlotIndex,
                                              modelOp.getSubgraphIndex());
  }

  Value intValue =
      IntGetCachedOp::create(builder, loc, builder.getIndexType(),
                             /*inChain=*/inChain, /*theContext=*/context,
                             /*bIntSlot=*/intSlotIndex);
  intValue = indexToDimension(builder, loc, intValue);
  return intValue;
}

/// Caches the integer and dimension results of a lifted op that 'execute'
/// still uses, and replaces those uses with values read back from the cache.
/// A compiled region that also returns a chain takes the chain path, so this
/// runs there too: otherwise its dims would move to 'init' with nothing in
/// 'execute' to read them back.
static void
cacheLiftedIndexResults(InitState &initState, ExecuteState &executeState,
                        Operation *liftedOp,
                        TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> cacheInputChain,
                        SmallVectorImpl<Value> &finalOutChains,
                        function_ref<bool(const OpOperand &)> isUnliftable) {
  for (Value oldIndexOut : getLiftableIndexOutputs(liftedOp)) {
    if (!llvm::any_of(oldIndexOut.getUses(), isUnliftable))
      continue;

    auto [cacheOutChain, currIndexSlot] =
        cacheIntValue(initState.builder, liftedOp->getLoc(), cacheInputChain,
                      initState.contextCreateOp, oldIndexOut);

    finalOutChains.push_back(cacheOutChain);

    auto newIndex = getCachedIntValue(
        executeState.builder, liftedOp->getLoc(), executeState.getContext(),
        executeState.getRootChain(), currIndexSlot, oldIndexOut.getType());

    oldIndexOut.replaceUsesWithIf(newIndex, isUnliftable);
    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
               << "will lift shape function output and replace old index:\n"
               << oldIndexOut << "\nwith:\n"
               << newIndex << "\nvia cached:\n"
               << cacheOutChain << "\n");
  }
}

/// Returns true if op is liftable but trivial to compute. Such an op is not
/// worth lifting unless another 'init' op needs it: caching and retrieving
/// its result costs more than recomputing it on every 'execute'.
static bool isLiftableTrivialOp(Operation *op) {
  if (isMemoryEffectFree(op))
    return true;

  if (auto liftableOp = dyn_cast<MGPLiftableBufferCreateOpInterface>(op))
    return liftableOp.isTrivial();
  return false;
}

/// Returns op's chain result if op can be lifted into 'init', else null. The
/// chain must then flow into the 'init' output chain, which feeds the
/// 'execute' input chain.
static Value getLiftableChainOp(Operation *op) {
  if (auto createChainOp = dyn_cast<GRT::ChainCreateOp>(op))
    return createChainOp.getResult();
  if (auto regionOp = dyn_cast<MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp>(op)) {
    // TODO(GEX-4344): The 'liftable' interfaces assume an op returns at most
    // one value, which forces this special case for multi-result regions.
    // A chain plus dimension results can move to 'init': the chain is ordered
    // there, and each dimension is cached. Any other extra result has no cache
    // slot, so the region stays in 'execute'. The cache round-trip stores an
    // index and restores a dimension, so a plain integer result would change
    // type on the way back.
    if (regionOp->getNumResults() > 1) {
      if (!isa<MEF::ChainType>(regionOp->getResult(0).getType()))
        return nullptr;
      for (Value result : llvm::drop_begin(regionOp->getResults()))
        if (!MOSH::ShapeAttr::isDimType(result.getType()))
          return nullptr;
      return regionOp->getResult(0);
    }
  }
  if (auto createChainOp = dyn_cast<MGPLiftableChainCreateOpInterface>(op))
    return createChainOp.getOutChain();
  return nullptr;
}

/// Return true if the result of op can be conveyed from the 'init' block
/// to the 'execute' block via the !mgp.context cache or 'execute' block
/// arguments.
static bool canBeConveyed(Operation *op) {
  return getLiftableBufferOp(op) || getLiftableChainOp(op) ||
         !getLiftableIndexOutputs(op).empty();
}

/// Returns true if op's result cannot be cached but op may run in both 'init'
/// and 'execute', which lets downstream ops be lifted too.
static bool isRecomputableOp(Operation *op) { return isMemoryEffectFree(op); }

/// Returns true if the execution of op could be safely lifted or copied to
/// the 'init' block without causing unintended side effects.
static bool canBeLifted(Operation *op) {
  // NOTE(MAXPLAT-70): some external constants are externally mutable (e.g.
  // torch tensors might be mutated by someone outside our stack), so we cannot
  // lift them to the init phase.
  if (auto externalConstOp = dyn_cast<BufferConstantExternalOp>(op))
    if (externalConstOp.getDHasAlias())
      return false;
  return canBeConveyed(op) || isRecomputableOp(op);
}

// The analyses below reuse the 'dense' machinery (per Value/OpOperand) though
// a 'sparse' per-Operation analysis would do. Control flow ops and their
// contents are treated as unliftable, overriding some default dataflow
// results.
// TODO(#24751): Support lifting of and from within control flow.

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// DependsOnArgsAnalysis
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

using OperationSet = IndexSet<Operation *>::Set;

/// A dense, forwards dataflow analysis to find ops which cannot be lifted
/// from the 'init' to the 'execute' block because:
///  - The op is already considered unliftable by an earlier analysis (if any).
///  - The op depends on an argument to the 'execute' block (other than the
///    !mef.chain and !mgp.context arguments).
///  - The op is a terminator.
///  - The op is, or is within, a control flow op.
///  - The op has side effects which must be observed on each call to the
///    'execute' block, and cannot instead be performed just once in the 'init'
///    block.
///  - The op depends on the result of an unliftable op.
///
/// We consider ops already in the 'init' block to be liftable so that
/// the 'init' block outputs don't taint the first two 'execute' block inputs
/// as being unliftable. This allows us to use the standard dataflow machinery.
///
/// During the analysis a value will be 'true' (ie mapped to a set containing
/// the distinguished value) if it is an 'execute' block arg or produced
/// by an unliftable op.
class DependsOnArgsAnalysis {
public:
  OperationSet unliftableOps;

  DependsOnArgsAnalysis(IndexSet<Value> *index,
                        IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex,
                        OperationSet unliftableOps)
      : unliftableOps(std::move(unliftableOps)), operationIndex(operationIndex),
        analysis(index), dependsOnArgsValues(index->emptySet()) {
    setup();
  }

  void print(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
    analysis.printPredicate(os, "dependsOnArgsValues", dependsOnArgsValues);
    llvm::dbgs() << "unliftable ops: ";
    operationIndex->printVs(llvm::dbgs(),
                            operationIndex->setToVector(unliftableOps));
    llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
  }

private:
  using Analysis = ForwardsRelationDataflowAnalysis;
  using DomainMap = Analysis::DomainMap;

  void flowGeneric(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool isAlreadyUnliftable = operationIndex->setContains(unliftableOps, op);
    Analysis::Set set = domainMap.bottom;
    for (Value operand : op->getOperands()) {
      domainMap.leastUpperBound(set,
                                analysis.getEntriesAndId(domainMap, operand));
    }
    bool hasUnliftableOperands =
        set.test(0); // distinguished always has index 0
    bool isNotLiftable = !canBeLifted(op);
    bool inControlFlow = !isExactlyOnce(op);
    bool isUnliftable = isAlreadyUnliftable || hasUnliftableOperands ||
                        isNotLiftable || inControlFlow;
    if (isUnliftable) {
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "DependsOnAnalysis: considering ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << " to be unliftable. isAlreadyUnliftable="
                     << isAlreadyUnliftable
                     << ", hasUnliftableOperands=" << hasUnliftableOperands
                     << ", isNotLiftable=" << isNotLiftable
                     << ", inControlFlow=" << inControlFlow << "\n";
      });
      operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
    }
    for (Value result : op->getResults()) {
      if (isUnliftable)
        analysis.setTrue(domainMap, result);
      else
        analysis.setDefault(domainMap, result);
    }
  }

  void flow(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool inInitBlock =
        op->getParentRegion()->isAncestor(&analysis.index->model.getInit());
    if (auto cfOp = dyn_cast<GRT::GRTControlFlowInterface>(op)) {
      analysis.flowControlFlow(
          cfOp, domainMap,
          std::bind(&DependsOnArgsAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
      if (!inInitBlock) {
        // Control flow ops and their results are intrinsically unliftable.
        operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
        for (Value result : op->getResults())
          analysis.setTrue(domainMap, result);
      }
    } else if (isa<MEF::OutputOp>(op)) {
      if (!inInitBlock) {
        operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
      }
    } else if (inInitBlock) {
      // Ignore 'init' block ops.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      flowGeneric(op, domainMap);
    }
  }

  void setup() {
    Analysis::Relation dependsOnArgsRelation;
    DomainMap domainMap(dependsOnArgsRelation, Analysis::kLubIsUnion,
                        analysis.index->emptySet(),
                        analysis.index->unitSet(analysis.index->distinguished));

    // The extra 'execute' args (ie not the !mef.chain, !mgp.context, weights
    // registry, or devices) vacuously depend on 'execute' args.
    for (Value arg : analysis.index->model.getExecuteInputs())
      analysis.setTrue(domainMap, arg);

    analysis.flowModel(analysis.index->model, domainMap,
                       std::bind(&DependsOnArgsAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    analysis.addToPredicate(dependsOnArgsValues, dependsOnArgsRelation);
  }

  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex;
  Analysis analysis;
  // Computed only for use by print for debugging.
  Analysis::Set dependsOnArgsValues;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// SuppressTrivialAnalysis
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// A dense, backwards dataflow analysis to find ops which cannot be lifted
/// from the 'init' to the 'execute' block because:
///  - the op is already considered unliftable by an earlier analysis.
///  - the op is trivial to compute and only used by unliftable ops, so
///    caching costs about as much as recomputing.
///  - the op's results are unused (DCE will remove it anyway).
///
/// During the analysis an operand will be 'true' (ie mapped to a set
/// containing the distinguished value) its using op is unliftable.
class SuppressTrivialAnalysis {
public:
  OperationSet unliftableOps;

  SuppressTrivialAnalysis(IndexSet<const OpOperand *> *index,
                          IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex,
                          OperationSet unliftableOps)
      : unliftableOps(std::move(unliftableOps)), operationIndex(operationIndex),
        analysis(index), suppressTrivialOperands(index->emptySet()) {
    setup();
  }

  void print(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
    analysis.printPredicate(os, "suppressTrivialOperands",
                            suppressTrivialOperands);
    llvm::dbgs() << "unliftable ops: ";
    operationIndex->printVs(llvm::dbgs(),
                            operationIndex->setToVector(unliftableOps));
    llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
  }

private:
  using Analysis = BackwardsRelationDataflowAnalysis;
  using DomainMap = Analysis::DomainMap;

  void flowGeneric(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool isAlreadyUnliftable = operationIndex->setContains(unliftableOps, op);
    bool isTrivial = isLiftableTrivialOp(op);
    Analysis::Set set = domainMap.bottom;
    for (OpOperand &operand : op->getUses()) {
      domainMap.leastUpperBound(set,
                                analysis.getEntriesAndId(domainMap, &operand));
    }
    bool allUsesUnliftable = set.test(0); // distinguished always has index 0
    bool isUnliftable = isAlreadyUnliftable || (isTrivial && allUsesUnliftable);
    if (isUnliftable) {
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "SuppressTrivialAnalysis: considering ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << " to be unliftable. isAlreadyUnliftable="
                     << isAlreadyUnliftable << ", isTrivial=" << isTrivial
                     << ", allUsesUnliftable=" << allUsesUnliftable << "\n";
      });
      operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
    }
    for (const OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands()) {
      if (isUnliftable)
        analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
      else
        analysis.setDefault(domainMap, &opOperand);
    }
  }

  void flow(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool inInitBlock =
        op->getParentRegion()->isAncestor(&analysis.index->model.getInit());
    if (auto cfOp = dyn_cast<GRT::GRTControlFlowInterface>(op)) {
      // Usual control flow rules.
      analysis.flowControlFlow(
          cfOp, domainMap,
          std::bind(&SuppressTrivialAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
      if (!inInitBlock) {
        // Control flow ops are unliftable, so all their operands are too.
        for (const OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands())
          analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
      }
    } else if (isa<MEF::OutputOp>(op)) {
      // Ignore 'plumbing'.
    } else if (inInitBlock) {
      // Ignore the 'init' block ops.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      flowGeneric(op, domainMap);
    }
  }

  void setup() {
    Analysis::Relation suppressTrivialRelation;
    DomainMap domainMap(suppressTrivialRelation, Analysis::kLubIsIntersection,
                        analysis.index->emptySet(),
                        analysis.index->unitSet(analysis.index->distinguished));

    // All 'execute' block outputs can be considered to be unliftable.
    for (OpOperand &result : analysis.index->model.getExecuteBlock()
                                 ->getTerminator()
                                 ->getOpOperands())
      analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &result);

    analysis.flowModel(analysis.index->model, domainMap,
                       std::bind(&SuppressTrivialAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    analysis.addToPredicate(suppressTrivialOperands, suppressTrivialRelation);
  }

  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex;
  Analysis analysis;
  // Computed only for use by print for debugging.
  Analysis::Set suppressTrivialOperands;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// SuppressMutatedAnalysis
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// A dense, backwards dataflow analysis to find ops which cannot be lifted
/// from the 'init' to the 'execute' block because:
///  - the op is already considered unliftable by an earlier analysis.
///  - at least one of the op's results is mutated by an op which cannot
///    be lifted. Since values held by the !mgp.context cache are read-only,
///    attempting to lift the op would result in a runtime error.
///
/// During the analysis an operand will be 'true' (ie mapped to a set
/// containing the distinguished value) if it is mutated by an unliftable op.
class SuppressMutatedAnalysis {
public:
  OperationSet unliftableOps;

  SuppressMutatedAnalysis(IndexSet<const OpOperand *> *index,
                          IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex,
                          OperationSet unliftableOps)
      : unliftableOps(std::move(unliftableOps)), operationIndex(operationIndex),
        analysis(index), suppressMutatedOperands(index->emptySet()) {
    setup();
  }

  void print(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
    analysis.printPredicate(os, "suppressMutatedOperands",
                            suppressMutatedOperands);
    llvm::dbgs() << "unliftable ops: ";
    operationIndex->printVs(llvm::dbgs(),
                            operationIndex->setToVector(unliftableOps));
    llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
  }

private:
  using Analysis = BackwardsRelationDataflowAnalysis;
  using DomainMap = Analysis::DomainMap;

  void flowGeneric(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool isAlreadyUnliftable = operationIndex->setContains(unliftableOps, op);
    Analysis::Set set = domainMap.bottom;
    for (OpOperand &operand : op->getUses()) {
      domainMap.leastUpperBound(set,
                                analysis.getEntriesAndId(domainMap, &operand));
    }
    bool anyUsesMutatedByUnliftable =
        set.test(0); // distinguished olways has index 0
    bool isUnliftable = isAlreadyUnliftable || anyUsesMutatedByUnliftable;
    if (isUnliftable) {
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "SuppressMutatedAnalysis: considering ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << " to be unliftable. isAlreadyUnliftable="
                     << isAlreadyUnliftable << ", anyUsesMutatedByUnliftable="
                     << anyUsesMutatedByUnliftable << "\n";
      });
      operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
    }
    // Only suppress upstream ops whose results this unliftable op *mutates*.
    for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands()) {
      if (isUnliftable && isMutated(opOperand))
        analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
      else
        analysis.setDefault(domainMap, &opOperand);
    }
  }

  void flow(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool inInitBlock =
        op->getParentRegion()->isAncestor(&analysis.index->model.getInit());
    if (auto cfOp = dyn_cast<GRT::GRTControlFlowInterface>(op)) {
      // Usual control flow rules.
      analysis.flowControlFlow(
          cfOp, domainMap,
          std::bind(&SuppressMutatedAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    } else if (isa<MEF::OutputOp>(op)) {
      // Ignore 'plumbing'.
    } else if (inInitBlock) {
      // Ignore the 'init' block ops.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      flowGeneric(op, domainMap);
    }
  }

  void setup() {
    Analysis::Relation suppressMutatedRelation;
    DomainMap domainMap(suppressMutatedRelation, Analysis::kLubIsUnion,
                        analysis.index->emptySet(),
                        analysis.index->unitSet(analysis.index->distinguished));

    // 'execute' block outputs are not mutated by the output, so stay 'false'.
    analysis.flowModel(analysis.index->model, domainMap,
                       std::bind(&SuppressMutatedAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    analysis.addToPredicate(suppressMutatedOperands, suppressMutatedRelation);
  }

  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex;
  Analysis analysis;
  // Computed only for use by print for debugging.
  Analysis::Set suppressMutatedOperands;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// NeedToCloneAnalysis
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// A dense, backwards dataflow analysis to find ops which, though liftable,
/// must also be 'left behind' in the 'execute' block by cloning. The op must
/// be cloned if it is i) liftable, and ii) its results cannot be conveyed via
/// the !mgp.context or 'execute' block args, and iii) any:
///  - it provides operands to an unliftable op
///  - it provides operands to an op already considered needing to be cloned
///    by this analysis.
///
/// During the analysis an operand will be 'true' (ie mapped to a set
/// containing the distinguished value) if it is an operand to an unliftable
/// op or an op already recognized as needing to be cloned.
class NeedToCloneAnalysis {
public:
  OperationSet clonedOps;

  NeedToCloneAnalysis(IndexSet<const OpOperand *> *index,
                      IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex,
                      const OperationSet &unliftableOps)
      : clonedOps(operationIndex->emptySet()), operationIndex(operationIndex),
        unliftableOps(unliftableOps), analysis(index),
        needToCloneOperands(index->emptySet()) {
    setup();
  }

  void print(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
    analysis.printPredicate(os, "needToCloneOperands", needToCloneOperands);
    llvm::dbgs() << "cloned ops: ";
    operationIndex->printVs(llvm::dbgs(),
                            operationIndex->setToVector(clonedOps));
    llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
  }

private:
  using Analysis = BackwardsRelationDataflowAnalysis;
  using DomainMap = Analysis::DomainMap;

  void flowGeneric(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    if (operationIndex->setContains(unliftableOps, op)) {
      // Ops which produce these operands may need to be cloned.
      for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands())
        analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
    } else if (canBeConveyed(op)) {
      // Results are recovered in 'execute', so operands constrain nothing
      // upstream.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      Analysis::Set set = domainMap.bottom;
      for (OpOperand &operand : op->getUses()) {
        domainMap.leastUpperBound(
            set, analysis.getEntriesAndId(domainMap, &operand));
      }
      bool neededByClonedOrUnliftable =
          set.test(0); // distinguished olways has index 0
      if (neededByClonedOrUnliftable) {
        LLVM_DEBUG({
          llvm::dbgs() << "NeedToCloneAnalysis: considering ";
          operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
          llvm::dbgs() << " to require cloning. neededByClonedOrUnliftable="
                       << neededByClonedOrUnliftable << "\n";
        });
        operationIndex->addToSet(clonedOps, op);
      }
      for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands()) {
        if (neededByClonedOrUnliftable)
          analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
        else
          analysis.setDefault(domainMap, &opOperand);
      }
    }
  }

  void flow(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool inInitBlock =
        op->getParentRegion()->isAncestor(&analysis.index->model.getInit());
    if (auto cfOp = dyn_cast<GRT::GRTControlFlowInterface>(op)) {
      // Usual control flow rules.
      analysis.flowControlFlow(
          cfOp, domainMap, std::bind(&NeedToCloneAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
      if (!inInitBlock) {
        // Control flow ops are unliftable, so all their operands are too.
        for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands())
          analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
      }
    } else if (isa<MEF::OutputOp>(op)) {
      // Ignore 'plumbing'.
    } else if (inInitBlock) {
      // Ignore 'init' block ops.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      flowGeneric(op, domainMap);
    }
  }

  void setup() {
    Analysis::Relation neededByExecuteRelation;
    DomainMap domainMap(neededByExecuteRelation, Analysis::kLubIsUnion,
                        analysis.index->emptySet(),
                        analysis.index->unitSet(analysis.index->distinguished));

    // All 'execute' block outputs are vacuously needed an unliftable op.
    for (OpOperand &result : analysis.index->model.getExecuteBlock()
                                 ->getTerminator()
                                 ->getOpOperands())
      analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &result);

    analysis.flowModel(analysis.index->model, domainMap,
                       std::bind(&NeedToCloneAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    analysis.addToPredicate(needToCloneOperands, neededByExecuteRelation);
  }

  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex;
  const OperationSet &unliftableOps;
  Analysis analysis;
  // Computed only for use by print for debugging.
  Analysis::Set needToCloneOperands;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// ExecInvariantCodeMotionPass
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

class ExecInvariantCodeMotionPass
    : public impl::ExecInvariantCodeMotionPassBase<
          ExecInvariantCodeMotionPass> {
  using ExecInvariantCodeMotionPassBase::ExecInvariantCodeMotionPassBase;

  // Returns the unliftable 'execute' ops and the liftable ones that must be
  // cloned before lifting.
  std::pair<OperationSet, OperationSet> analyze(ModelOp modelOp) {
    OperationSet unliftableOps = operationIndex->emptySet();
    size_t origNumUnliftableOps;

    do {
      origNumUnliftableOps = unliftableOps.count();
      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "-------- analysis iteration --------\n");

      // Don't lift if depends on 'execute' block args.
      DependsOnArgsAnalysis dependsOnArgsAnalysis(valueIndex, operationIndex,
                                                  std::move(unliftableOps));
      LLVM_DEBUG(dependsOnArgsAnalysis.print(llvm::dbgs()));

      // Don't lift if trivial to recompute and only used by unliftable.
      SuppressTrivialAnalysis suppressTrivialAnalysis(
          operandIndex, operationIndex,
          std::move(dependsOnArgsAnalysis.unliftableOps));
      LLVM_DEBUG(suppressTrivialAnalysis.print(llvm::dbgs()));

      // Don't lift if mutated by an unliftable op.
      SuppressMutatedAnalysis suppressMutatedAnalysis(
          operandIndex, operationIndex,
          std::move(suppressTrivialAnalysis.unliftableOps));
      LLVM_DEBUG(suppressMutatedAnalysis.print(llvm::dbgs()));

      unliftableOps = std::move(suppressMutatedAnalysis.unliftableOps);
    } while (origNumUnliftableOps < unliftableOps.count());

    NeedToCloneAnalysis needToCloneAnalysis(operandIndex, operationIndex,
                                            unliftableOps);

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "-------- analysis fixed point --------------\n";
      needToCloneAnalysis.print(llvm::dbgs());
      llvm::dbgs() << "--------------------------------------------\n";
    });

    return {std::move(unliftableOps), std::move(needToCloneAnalysis.clonedOps)};
  }

  void rewrite(const std::pair<OperationSet, OperationSet> &sets) {
    DenseSet<Operation *> unliftableOps;
    for (Operation *op : operationIndex->values(sets.first))
      unliftableOps.insert(op);
    DenseSet<Operation *> cloneOps;
    for (Operation *op : operationIndex->values(sets.second))
      cloneOps.insert(op);

    auto isOpOperandUnliftable = [&unliftableOps](const OpOperand &operand) {
      return unliftableOps.contains(operand.getOwner());
    };

    auto initOutputOp = cast<MEF::OutputOp>(*initState->init->rbegin());
    Value initOriginalChain = initState->getFinalChain();
    Location outputLoc = initOutputOp.getLoc();
    initState->builder.setInsertionPoint(initOutputOp);

    // A host-chain placeholder gating the caching of lifted buffers until all
    // side effects on them complete; replaced once lifting is done.
    auto placeholderBufferCacheInputChain =
        GRT::ChainCreateOp::create(initState->builder, outputLoc);

    // TODO(#24751): The following chain dependencies may be too aggressive,
    // relax via some analysis

    // Chains of side effects on lifted buffers; caching waits for ALL of them.
    SmallVector<Value> potentialBufferActionChains;

    // Cache-insertion chains, joined into the final 'init' output chain.
    SmallVector<Value> finalOutChains{initOriginalChain};

    // TODO(#24751): We only consider ops in the top-level 'execute' block.
    SmallVector<Operation *> allOps = getDataflowOrder(executeState->execute);

    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "first pass...\n");

    // Clone in a separate first pass so lifted results are renamed in the
    // right places.
    IRMapping cloneIRMapping;
    for (Operation *op : allOps) {
      if (!cloneOps.contains(op))
        continue;
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "cloning ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
      });
      ASSERT_STREAM(!unliftableOps.contains(op),
                    << "attempting to clone an op (" << *op
                    << ") which is unliftable");
      ASSERT_STREAM(isRecomputableOp(op), << "attempting to clone an op ("
                                          << *op
                                          << ") which is not recomputable");

      // For easier debugging only.
      executeState->builder.setInsertionPoint(op);

      Operation *clonedOp = executeState->builder.clone(*op, cloneIRMapping);
      // Clones stay in 'execute'.
      unliftableOps.insert(clonedOp);
      op->replaceUsesWithIf(clonedOp, isOpOperandUnliftable);
    }

    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "second pass...\n");

    for (Operation *op : allOps) {
      if (unliftableOps.contains(op))
        continue;
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "moving ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
      });

      // For easier debugging only.
      executeState->builder.setInsertionPoint(op);

      if (Value oldChain = getLiftableChainOp(op)) {
        // Uses staying in 'execute' switch to its root chain (CSE dedups);
        // other uses are lifted along with op.
        Value newChain = executeState->getRootChain();
        oldChain.replaceUsesWithIf(newChain, isOpOperandUnliftable);
        LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "will lift chain op and replace old chain:\n"
                                << oldChain << "\nwith:\n"
                                << newChain << "\n");
        cacheLiftedIndexResults(*initState, *executeState, op,
                                placeholderBufferCacheInputChain,
                                finalOutChains, isOpOperandUnliftable);

      } else if (Value oldBuffer = getLiftableBufferOp(op)) {
        // Uses staying in 'execute' read the buffer back from the cache.
        if (llvm::any_of(op->getUses(), isOpOperandUnliftable)) {
          // Caching must wait for every writer. Rather than track writers per
          // buffer, *all* buffers wait for *all* writers.
          for (OpOperand &use : op->getUses()) {
            if (isMutated(use)) {
              // Fires when the parent is liftable but a "trivial" child is
              // not. Cloning the parent or moving the child would fix it, but
              // very few ops are trivial.
              ASSERT_STREAM(!isOpOperandUnliftable(use),
                            << "attempting to lift buffer (" << *op
                            << ") which will be further mutated "
                               "in the 'execute' block");
              for (Value res : use.getOwner()->getResults()) {
                if (isa<MEF::MEFChainTypeInterface>(res.getType()))
                  potentialBufferActionChains.push_back(res);
              }
            }
          }

          MGPBufferBuilder *bufferBuilder =
              TensorBufferDialectInterface::getBuilderForTypeStorage(
                  *builderContext, oldBuffer.getType());
          auto [bufferCacheOutChain, currBufferSlot] = bufferBuilder->cache(
              initState->builder, op->getLoc(), initState->getContext(),
              placeholderBufferCacheInputChain, initState->contextCreateOp,
              oldBuffer);

          finalOutChains.push_back(bufferCacheOutChain);

          auto newBuffer = bufferBuilder->getCached(
              executeState->builder, op->getLoc(), executeState->getContext(),
              executeState->getRootChain(), currBufferSlot,
              oldBuffer.getType());

          oldBuffer.replaceUsesWithIf(newBuffer, isOpOperandUnliftable);
          LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                     << "will lift buffer op and replace old buffer:\n"
                     << oldBuffer << "\nwith:\n"
                     << newBuffer << "\nvia cached:\n"
                     << bufferCacheOutChain << "\n");
        } else {
          LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "will lift buffer op without caching\n");
        }

      } else if (!getLiftableIndexOutputs(op).empty()) {
        cacheLiftedIndexResults(*initState, *executeState, op,
                                placeholderBufferCacheInputChain,
                                finalOutChains, isOpOperandUnliftable);

      } else {
        ASSERT_STREAM(isRecomputableOp(op),
                      << "attempting to lift an op (" << *op
                      << ") which is neither a liftable chain or "
                         "buffer op, nor a recomputable op");

        // Note that the op may have been cloned by the first pass.
      }

      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "considering op to be recomputable:\n"
                              << *op << "\n");
      op->moveBefore(initOutputOp);
    }

    auto isInInitBlock = [this](OpOperand &operand) -> bool {
      return operand.getOwner()->getBlock() == initState->init;
    };

    // Lifted ops now use the 'init' equivalents of the 'execute' block args;
    // the chain is the 'init' output chain from before the updates above.
    executeState->getRootChain().replaceUsesWithIf(initOriginalChain,
                                                   isInInitBlock);

    executeState->getContext().replaceUsesWithIf(initState->contextCreateOp,
                                                 isInInitBlock);

    for (auto [execDeviceContext, initDeviceContext] :
         llvm::zip(executeState->getDevices(), initState->getDevices()))
      execDeviceContext.replaceUsesWithIf(initDeviceContext, isInInitBlock);

    executeState->getWeightsRegistry().replaceUsesWithIf(
        initState->getWeightsRegistry(), isInInitBlock);

    placeholderBufferCacheInputChain.replaceAllUsesWith(
        GRT::ChainCreateOp::create(initState->builder, outputLoc,
                                   potentialBufferActionChains)
            .getResult());
    placeholderBufferCacheInputChain.erase();

    auto mergedFinalOutChain = GRT::ChainCreateOp::create(
        initState->builder, outputLoc, finalOutChains);
    initState->updateFinalChain(mergedFinalOutChain);
  }

  void runOnOperation() override {
    assert(!initState && !executeState && !valueIndex && !operandIndex &&
           !operationIndex && !builderContext);
    ModelOp modelOp = getOperation();
    InitState theInitState(modelOp);
    initState = &theInitState;
    ExecuteState theExecuteState(modelOp.getContext(), modelOp);
    executeState = &theExecuteState;
    IndexSet<Value> theValueIndex = createValueIndexSet(modelOp);
    valueIndex = &theValueIndex;
    IndexSet<const OpOperand *> theOperandIndex =
        createOperandIndexSet(modelOp);
    operandIndex = &theOperandIndex;
    IndexSet<Operation *> theOperationIndex = createOperationIndexSet(modelOp);
    operationIndex = &theOperationIndex;

    BufferBuilderContext theBuilderContext =
        TensorBufferDialectInterface::getAllBufferBuilders(modelOp);
    builderContext = &theBuilderContext;

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "-------- before ExecInvariantCodeMotionPass --------\n";
      valueIndex->printModel(llvm::dbgs());
      llvm::dbgs() << "----------------------------------------------------\n";
    });

    rewrite(analyze(modelOp));

    // Clear state because the instance might be reused
    builderContext = nullptr;
    operationIndex = nullptr;
    operandIndex = nullptr;
    valueIndex = nullptr;
    executeState = nullptr;
    initState = nullptr;
  }

  /// Rewrite helpers.
  InitState *initState = nullptr;
  ExecuteState *executeState = nullptr;
  IndexSet<Value> *valueIndex = nullptr;
  IndexSet<const OpOperand *> *operandIndex = nullptr;
  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex = nullptr;

  /// All the type and buffer builders we'll need while working on the model.
  BufferBuilderContext *builderContext = nullptr;
};
