// RUN: mo-opt %s --mgp-finalize-device-graphs --allow-unregistered-dialect --split-input-file | FileCheck %s

// The `mgp.device_graph.collective` op of an `isDeviceGraph` model is lifted
// into a `mgp.device_graph.collective.create` wrapped in
// a `mogg.routine.async` (so it compiles via the kernel path), plus
// a bare `mgp.device_graph.collective.execute` that replays the graph bundle;
// `mef.output` is rewired to the execute op's outputs.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg
// CHECK: execute (%[[CH0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mef.chain, %[[CTX:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.context, %{{.+}}: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %[[GPU:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %[[IN:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>)

// CHECK: %[[GRAPH:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[CTX]], %[[GPU]], %[[IN]]) : (%{{.+}}: !mgp.context, %{{.+}}: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %{{.+}}: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>)  -> !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>> {
// CHECK: mogg.async.unpack

// CHECK: %[[CACHE:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.cache %{{.+}} : !mgp.device_graph.cache
// CHECK: %[[CGRAPH:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.collective.create %{{.+}} cache(%[[CACHE]] : !mgp.device_graph.cache) graph(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) builder(%b0) inputs(%{{.+}} : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.yield %{{.+}} : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: mogg.async.pack
// CHECK: mogg.output

// CHECK: %{{[a-zA-Z0-9_]+}}, %[[RES:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.collective.execute %[[GRAPH]]
// CHECK: mef.output %[[CH0]], %[[RES]] : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.collective builder

mgp.model @dg device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  %out = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable() <"gpu", 0> {
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %in : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  } : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  mef.output %ch0, %out : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// A model WITHOUT `isDeviceGraph` is left untouched: no create/execute is
// introduced and the staging op stays.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @not_dg
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.staging
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.collective.create

mgp.model @not_dg : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  %out = mgp.device_graph.staging inputs(%in : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  ^bb0(%builder: !mgp.device_graph.builder,
       %in_t: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>):
    mgp.device_graph.staging.yield %in_t : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  } -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  mef.output %ch0, %out : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// Device graphs have no chain concept. When the collective body yields a chain
// (host-side sequencing) in addition to its value output, finalize must
// (a) keep `!mef.chain` out of the `mgp.device_graph` signature entirely and
// (b) give `mgp.device_graph.collective.execute` its own fresh completion chain
// result, then rewire the collective op's chain result to it.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_chain
// The graph signature is chain-free on BOTH sides (inputs and results).
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.create %{{.+}} cache(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_graph.cache) graph(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) builder(%b0) inputs(
// CHECK: } : !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
// The execute op produces a completion chain (result #0) + the value output; the
// collective op's chain result is rewired to that chain (fed to `mef.output`).
// CHECK: %[[CHAIN:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]], %[[RES:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.collective.execute
// CHECK: mef.output %[[CHAIN]], %[[RES]] : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.collective builder
mgp.model @dg_chain device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  %c0:2 = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable() <"gpu", 0> {
    %r = "test.identity"(%in) : (!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    // Host-side "done" chain, yielded as a graph output today; must be dropped.
    %done = "test.make_chain"() : () -> !mef.chain
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %done, %r : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  } : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  mef.output %c0#0, %c0#1 : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// `mgp-compute-device-graph-dependencies` re-sources an in-body device context
// from the recording builder through an unrealized cast, expecting the consumer
// to be rewritten to take the builder (as `mgp.buffer.alloc` is). A consumer
// that genuinely needs a device context -- `mgp.buffer.bulk_slice`, which only
// does host-side sub-buffer math -- leaves the cast live, and an unrealized cast
// cannot be emitted to Mojo. Finalize replaces it with the real accessor op.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_builder_context
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.create
// The cast lives in a `dependencies` body, so it is that body's builder arg --
// not the create body's -- that the accessor op reads.
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.dependencies builder(%{{.*}})
// CHECK-NEXT: ^bb0(%[[DB:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.device_graph.builder):
// CHECK: %[[CTX:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.device_context %[[DB]] : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: mgp.buffer.bulk_slice %{{.+}}, %[[CTX]] offsets
// CHECK-NOT: unrealized_conversion_cast
mgp.model @dg_builder_context device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %out = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable() <"gpu", 0> {
    %node, %r = mgp.device_graph.dependencies builder(%b) dependencies() {
    ^bb0(%dep_builder: !mgp.device_graph.builder):
      %dev = builtin.unrealized_conversion_cast %dep_builder : !mgp.device_graph.builder to !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
      %off = "test.offset"() : () -> index
      %size = "test.size"() : () -> index
      %slice = mgp.buffer.bulk_slice %in, %dev offsets(%off) sizes(%size) : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
      mgp.device_graph.dependencies.yield %slice : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
    } : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %r : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
  } : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
  mef.output %ch0, %out : !mef.chain, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// A `builder -> device context -> builder` round trip (what
// `mgp-generate-build-graph-stubs` leaves behind when it rewrites
// `mgp.buffer.alloc` into the builder-native `mgp.device_graph.alloc`) must fold
// away entirely. Converting the first cast to `mgp.device_graph.device_context`
// before folding would strand the inverse cast, so no accessor op may appear.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_builder_round_trip
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.create
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.dependencies
// CHECK-NEXT: ^bb0(%[[DB:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.device_graph.builder):
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.alloc %{{.+}}, %{{.+}}, %[[DB]], align 256
// CHECK-NOT: unrealized_conversion_cast
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.device_context
mgp.model @dg_builder_round_trip device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %out = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable() <"gpu", 0> {
    %node, %r = mgp.device_graph.dependencies builder(%b) dependencies() {
    ^bb0(%dep_builder: !mgp.device_graph.builder):
      %dev = builtin.unrealized_conversion_cast %dep_builder : !mgp.device_graph.builder to !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
      %back = builtin.unrealized_conversion_cast %dev : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>> to !mgp.device_graph.builder
      %bch = "test.make_chain"() : () -> !mef.chain
      %size = "test.size"() : () -> index
      %buf = mgp.device_graph.alloc %bch, %size, %back, align 256 : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
      mgp.device_graph.dependencies.yield %buf : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
    } : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %r : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
  } : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
  mef.output %ch0, %out : !mef.chain, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// A collective body may yield one of the values it captures from outside (a
// `mgp.device_graph.dependencies` body result that is itself an outer input).
// The finalize pass remaps that capture to the create op's per-region input
// arg when cloning the body, so the `mgp.device_graph.yield` and any other uses
// end up referencing the right value.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_passthrough
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.create %{{.+}} cache(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_graph.cache) graph(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) builder(%b0) inputs(
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.yield %{{.+}} : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.execute
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.collective builder
mgp.model @dg_passthrough device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  %out = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable() <"gpu", 0> {
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %in : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  } : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  mef.output %ch0, %out : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// A mut-marked input (the lowered form of !mo.buffer) flows through finalization
// with its type spelled verbatim at every boundary: the compiled region's
// signature, the create op's inputs and block args, the graph signature, and the
// execute op's inputs.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_mut_input
// CHECK: execute (%[[CH0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mef.chain, %[[CTX:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.context, %{{.+}}: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %[[GPU:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %[[IN:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>)
// CHECK: mogg.routine.async (%[[CTX]], %[[GPU]], %[[IN]]) : (%{{.+}}: !mgp.context, %{{.+}}: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %{{.+}}: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>)  -> !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>>
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.create %{{.+}} cache(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_graph.cache) graph(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) builder(%b0) inputs(%{{.+}} : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) {
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.yield %{{.+}} : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>
// CHECK: } : !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>>
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.execute
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.collective builder

mgp.model @dg_mut_input device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) {

// -----

// A multi-device `mgp.device_graph.collective` with no stable-address slots
// lowers to a single `mogg.routine.async` that builds all graphs
// via `mgp.device_graph.collective.create`, followed by a host-side
// `mgp.device_graph.collective.execute`.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_collective
// CHECK: execute (%[[CH:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mef.chain, %[[CTX:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.context, %{{.+}}: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %[[GPU0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %[[GPU1:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>, %[[IN0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %[[IN1:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>)
// CHECK: %[[GRAPHS:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]:2 = mogg.routine.async (%[[CTX]], %[[GPU0]], %[[GPU1]], %[[IN0]], %[[IN1]]) : (%{{.+}}: !mgp.context, %{{.+}}: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %{{.+}}: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>, %{{.+}}: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %{{.+}}: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>)  -> (!mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>, !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>>)
// CHECK: %[[CACHE:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.cache %{{.+}} : !mgp.device_graph.cache
// CHECK: %[[CGRAPHS:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]:2 = mgp.device_graph.collective.create %{{.+}} cache(%[[CACHE]] : !mgp.device_graph.cache) graph(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) builder(%b0) inputs(%[[RI0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
// CHECK:   mgp.device_graph.yield %[[RI0]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: }, graph(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>) builder(%b1) inputs(%[[RI1:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>) {
// CHECK:   mgp.device_graph.yield %[[RI1]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
// CHECK: } : !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>, !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>>
// CHECK: %{{[a-zA-Z0-9_]+}}, %[[OUTS:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]:2 = mgp.device_graph.collective.execute %[[GRAPHS]]#0, %[[GRAPHS]]#1 inputs(%[[IN0]], %[[IN1]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>) : !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>, !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>> -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
// CHECK: mef.output %[[CH]], %[[OUTS]]#0, %[[OUTS]]#1 : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.collective builder

mgp.model @dg_collective device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>, #M.device_ref<"gpu", 1>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu0: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %gpu1: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu0, %gpu1
      : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">,
        !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">,
           %gpu0: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %gpu1: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>,
           %in0: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %in1: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>)
    -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>) {
  %c0, %c1 = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable() <"gpu", 0> {
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %in0 : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  }, <"gpu", 1> {
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %in1 : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
  } : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>

  mef.output %ch0, %c0, %c1
      : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
}

// -----

// A host-placed tensor input (dispatch metadata) flows through finalization
// with its cpu placement spelled verbatim at every boundary; the graph device
// still resolves from the gpu output, not the host input.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_host_input
// The host input is captured first (it is used textually before the gpu input
// in the body), so it lands before the gpu input in the create/execute input
// lists and the graph signature.
// CHECK: mogg.routine.async
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.create %{{.+}} cache(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_graph.cache) graph(%{{.+}} : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) builder(%b0) inputs(%{{.+}} : !mgp.tensor<4xsi64>, %{{.+}} : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
// CHECK: } : !mgp.device_graph<(!mgp.tensor<4xsi64>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.execute
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.collective builder

mgp.model @dg_host_input device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %h: !mgp.tensor<4xsi64, <"cpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  %out = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable() <"gpu", 0> {
    // The host input is read inside the body (would key the cache); keep it used.
    "test.use_host"(%h) : (!mgp.tensor<4xsi64, <"cpu", 0>>) -> ()
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %in : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  } : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  mef.output %ch0, %out : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// Stable address slots are declared on the collective rather than passed as
// values, so finalization needs no capture plumbing for them: the regions
// reach slots by index through the builder, the one block argument
// finalization already remaps. The declaration is copied onto the create op
// so emission can allocate the slots.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_stable_slots
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.create
// CHECK-SAME: builder(%[[B0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]])
// CHECK: %[[P0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.stable.place %[[B0]][0], %[[IN0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: %[[S0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.tensor.extract.tensor_spec %[[IN0]]
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.stable.tensor %[[P0]], %[[S0]] : !mgp.stable_addr<<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
// CHECK: builder(%[[B1:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]])
// CHECK: %[[A0:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.stable.get %[[B1]][0] : !mgp.stable_addr<<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
// CHECK: %[[S1:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.tensor_spec.create : !mgp.tensor_spec<2x3xf32>
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.stable.tensor %[[A0]], %[[S1]] : !mgp.stable_addr<<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
// CHECK: {stableTypes = #mgp<stable_addr_array[<<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>]>}
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.execute
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.collective builder

mgp.model @dg_stable_slots device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>, #M.device_ref<"gpu", 1>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu0: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %gpu1: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu0, %gpu1
      : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">,
        !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">,
           %gpu0: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %gpu1: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>,
           %in0: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %in1: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>)
    -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>) {
  %c0, %c1 = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable(
      !mgp.stable_addr<<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
  ) <"gpu", 0> {
    %p0 = mgp.device_graph.stable.place %b[0], %in0 : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %s0 = mgp.tensor.extract.tensor_spec %in0 : <2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %t0 = mgp.device_graph.stable.tensor %p0, %s0 : !mgp.stable_addr<<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %in0 : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  }, <"gpu", 1> {
    %a0 = mgp.device_graph.stable.get %b[0] : !mgp.stable_addr<<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
    %s1 = mgp.tensor_spec.create : !mgp.tensor_spec<2x3xf32>
    %t1 = mgp.device_graph.stable.tensor %a0, %s1 : !mgp.stable_addr<<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %in1 : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
  } : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>

  mef.output %ch0, %c0, %c1
      : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
}

// -----

// A tensor a region reads only for its shape is recorded on the create op by
// its flat input position. gpu:1's region takes gpu:0's tensor, but every use
// is a spec extraction, so that input (region 0 contributes one input before
// it) is shape-only; gpu:1's own tensor, whose buffer is read, is not.
//
// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_shape_only_input
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.collective.create
// CHECK: shapeOnlyInputs = array<i64: 1>

mgp.model @dg_shape_only_input device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>, #M.device_ref<"gpu", 1>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu0: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %gpu1: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu0, %gpu1
      : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">,
        !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">,
           %gpu0: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %gpu1: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 1>>,
           %in0: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %in1: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>)
    -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>) {
  %c0, %c1 = mgp.device_graph.collective builder(%b) stable() <"gpu", 0> {
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %in0 : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  }, <"gpu", 1> {
    // By finalization the dependency pass has inlined the host bookkeeping:
    // gpu:0's tensor is read only for its shape, gpu:1's for its buffer.
    %spec = mgp.tensor.extract.tensor_spec %in0 : <2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %ch = mogg.chain.dummy()
    %buf = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %in1 : <2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
    %r = mgp.tensor.create %ch, %buf, %spec : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
    mgp.device_graph.collective.yield %r : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
  } : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
  mef.output %ch0, %c0, %c1 : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 1>>
}

// RUN: mo-opt %s --allow-unregistered-dialect --mgp-simple-buffer-reuse --split-input-file | FileCheck %s

// This test case covers the case of serial execution commonly found in models
//
//     execute(in %inBuffer, out %alloc0)
//  -> execute(%alloc0, %alloc1)
//  -> execute(%alloc1, %alloc2)
//
// Since %alloc2's first use occurs after the last use of %alloc0, we can safely reuse %alloc0
//
//     execute(in %inBuffer, out %alloc0)
//  -> execute(in %alloc0, out %alloc1)
//  -> execute(in %alloc1, out %alloc0)

mgp.model @serial : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>] init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %cpu: !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>) {
  %0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %1 = mgp.context.create 2
  mef.output %0, %1, %weights, %cpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>

} execute (%arg0: !mef.chain, %arg1: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %cpu: !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>, %inTensor: !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>) {
  // CHECK: %[[INBUFFER:.*]] = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer
  %inBuffer = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %inTensor : !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>
  %inTensorSpec = mgp.tensor.extract.tensor_spec %inTensor : <?x?xf32>
  %inDims0 = mgp.tensor_spec.get_dim[0] %inTensorSpec : !mgp.tensor_spec<?x?xf32>
  %inDims1 = mgp.tensor_spec.get_dim[1] %inTensorSpec : !mgp.tensor_spec<?x?xf32>

  %allocSize = index.mul %inDims0, %inDims1

  // We only expect 2 remaining allocs after the pass

  // CHECK: %[[ALLOC0:.*]] = mgp.buffer.alloc {{.*}}
  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[ALLOC1:.*]] = mgp.buffer.alloc {{.*}}
  %alloc0 = mgp.buffer.alloc %arg0, %allocSize, %cpu, align 16 : !mgp.buffer, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>
  %alloc1 = mgp.buffer.alloc %arg0, %allocSize, %cpu, align 16 : !mgp.buffer, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>
  %alloc2 = mgp.buffer.alloc %arg0, %allocSize, %cpu, align 16 : !mgp.buffer, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>


  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[CH0:.*]] = "kernel_execute"(%{{.*}}, %[[INBUFFER]], %[[ALLOC0]])
  %outChain_0 = "kernel_execute"(%arg0, %inBuffer, %alloc0) : (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer, !mgp.buffer) -> !mef.chain
  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[CH1:.*]] = "kernel_execute"(%{{.*}}, %[[ALLOC0]], %[[ALLOC1]])
  %outChain_1 = "kernel_execute"(%outChain_0, %alloc0, %alloc1) : (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer, !mgp.buffer) -> !mef.chain
  // Check to make sure all uses of %alloc2 are replaced with %alloc0
  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[CH2:.*]] = "kernel_execute"(%[[CH1]], %[[ALLOC1]], %[[ALLOC0]])
  %outChain_2 = "kernel_execute"(%outChain_1, %alloc1, %alloc2) : (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer, !mgp.buffer) -> !mef.chain

  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[OUTTENSOR:.*]] = mgp.tensor.create %[[CH2]]
  %outTensor = mgp.tensor.create %outChain_2, %alloc2, %inTensorSpec : !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>
  mef.output %arg0, %outTensor : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>
}

// -----

// This test case covers the same case of serial execution as above.
// Even though the lifetimes are the same as above and indicate that the buffer
// can be reused, the sizes are different so the simple buffer reuse pass will
// not reuse.
mgp.model @serial_negative : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>] init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %cpu: !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>) {
  %0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %1 = mgp.context.create 2
  mef.output %0, %1, %weights, %cpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>

} execute (%arg0: !mef.chain, %arg1: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %cpu: !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>, %inTensor: !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>) {
  // CHECK: %[[INBUFFER:.*]] = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer
  %inBuffer = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %inTensor : !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>
  %inTensorSpec = mgp.tensor.extract.tensor_spec %inTensor : <?x?xf32>
  %inDims0 = mgp.tensor_spec.get_dim[0] %inTensorSpec : !mgp.tensor_spec<?x?xf32>
  %inDims1 = mgp.tensor_spec.get_dim[1] %inTensorSpec : !mgp.tensor_spec<?x?xf32>

  %allocSize = index.mul %inDims0, %inDims1
  %allocSizeDifferent = index.add %inDims0, %inDims1


  // We still expect 3 remaining allocs after the pass

  // CHECK: %[[ALLOC0:.*]] = mgp.buffer.alloc {{.*}}
  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[ALLOC1:.*]] = mgp.buffer.alloc {{.*}}
  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[ALLOC2:.*]] = mgp.buffer.alloc {{.*}}
  %alloc0 = mgp.buffer.alloc %arg0, %allocSize, %cpu, align 16 : !mgp.buffer, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>
  %alloc1 = mgp.buffer.alloc %arg0, %allocSize, %cpu, align 16 : !mgp.buffer, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>
  %alloc2 = mgp.buffer.alloc %arg0, %allocSizeDifferent, %cpu, align 16 : !mgp.buffer, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>


  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[CH0:.*]] = "kernel_execute"({{.*}}, %[[INBUFFER]], %[[ALLOC0]])
  %outChain_0 = "kernel_execute"(%arg0, %inBuffer, %alloc0) : (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer, !mgp.buffer) -> !mef.chain
  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[CH1:.*]] = "kernel_execute"({{.*}}, %[[ALLOC0]], %[[ALLOC1]])
  %outChain_1 = "kernel_execute"(%outChain_0, %alloc0, %alloc1) : (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer, !mgp.buffer) -> !mef.chain
  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[CH2:.*]] = "kernel_execute"(%[[CH1]], %[[ALLOC1]], %[[ALLOC2]])
  %outChain_2 = "kernel_execute"(%outChain_1, %alloc1, %alloc2) : (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer, !mgp.buffer) -> !mef.chain

  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[OUTTENSOR:.*]] = mgp.tensor.create %[[CH2]]
  %outTensor = mgp.tensor.create %outChain_2, %alloc2, %inTensorSpec : !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>
  mef.output %arg0, %outTensor : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>
}


// -----

// A buffer published through a stable address slot is read by other devices'
// regions of the partitioned device graph, which never show up as uses of the
// buffer here. The lifetime analysis gives up at the stable create, so the
// buffer is never a reuse candidate even though its visible uses all precede
// the consumer's.
mgp.model @stable_slot_not_reused : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>] init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %1 = mgp.context.create 2
  mef.output %0, %1, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>

} execute (%arg0: !mef.chain, %arg1: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %inTensor: !mgp.tensor<4xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<4xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  %inBuffer = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %inTensor : <4xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  %spec = mgp.tensor.extract.tensor_spec %inTensor : <4xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  %size = index.constant 16

  // CHECK: %[[ALLOC0:.*]] = mgp.buffer.alloc
  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[ALLOC1:.*]] = mgp.buffer.alloc
  %alloc0 = mgp.buffer.alloc %arg0, %size, %gpu, align 16 : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
  %alloc1 = mgp.buffer.alloc %arg0, %size, %gpu, align 16 : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>

  // CHECK-NEXT: %[[CH0:.*]] = "kernel_execute"(%{{.*}}, %{{.*}}, %[[ALLOC0]])
  %ch0 = "kernel_execute"(%arg0, %inBuffer, %alloc0) : (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>) -> !mef.chain
  %t0 = mgp.tensor.create %ch0, %alloc0, %spec : !mgp.tensor<4xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  %s0 = mgp.device_graph.stable.create %t0 : !mgp.tensor<4xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  %sb = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %s0 : <4xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>

  // The consumer keeps its own output buffer.
  // CHECK: "kernel_execute"(%[[CH0]], %{{.*}}, %[[ALLOC1]])
  %ch1 = "kernel_execute"(%ch0, %sb, %alloc1) : (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>) -> !mef.chain

  %out = mgp.tensor.create %ch1, %alloc1, %spec : !mgp.tensor<4xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  mef.output %arg0, %out : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<4xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// RUN: mo-opt %s --allow-unregistered-dialect --mgp-async-dataflow-dependencies-test --mgp-simplify-chains --cse --mlir-disable-threading | FileCheck %s

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @chains : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>] init (%arg0: !mgp.opaque{{.*}}
mgp.model @chains : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>] init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %cpu: !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>) {

  mef.output %0, %1, %weights, %cpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>
// CHECK: execute (%[[CH0:.*]]: !mef.chain,
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %arg1: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %cpu: !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>) -> !mef.chain {
  // %ch1 -> %ch0
  %ch1 = grt.chain.create (%ch0)
  // %ch2 -> %ch0
  %ch2 = grt.chain.create (%ch1, %ch1)
  // CHECK: %[[CH3:.*]] = "some.op1"(%[[CH0]])
  %ch3 = "some.op1"(%ch2) : (!mef.chain) -> !mef.chain
  // %ch4 -> %ch3
  %ch4 = grt.chain.create (%ch0, %ch3)
  // CHECK: %[[CH5:.*]] = "some.op2"(%[[CH3]])
  %ch5 = "some.op2"(%ch4) : (!mef.chain) -> !mef.chain
  // CHECK: %[[CH6:.*]] = "some.op3"(%[[CH3]])
  %ch6 = "some.op3"(%ch4) : (!mef.chain) -> !mef.chain
  // CHECK: %[[CH7:.*]] = "some.op4"(%[[CH3]])
  %ch7 = "some.op4"(%ch4) : (!mef.chain) -> !mef.chain
  // Dead
  %ch8 = grt.chain.create (%ch5, %ch6)
  // %ch9 -> grt.chain.create(%[[CH5]], %[[CH6]], %[[CH7]])
  // Dead
  %ch9 = grt.chain.create (%ch4, %ch8, %ch7)
  // CHECK: %[[CH10:.*]] = grt.chain.create ()
  %ch10 = grt.chain.create ()
  // Dead
  %ch11 = grt.chain.create (%ch10, %ch9)
  %c = "some.op5"() : () -> i1
  // CHECK: %[[CH12:.*]] = grt.if %{{.*}} (%[[CH10]]: !mef.chain) -> !mef.chain {
  %ch12 = grt.if %c (%ch10 : !mef.chain) -> !mef.chain {
    mef.output %ch10 : !mef.chain
  } else {
    // CHECK: %[[CH13:.*]] = grt.chain.create ()
    %ch13 = grt.chain.create ()
    // CHECK: mef.output %[[CH13]]
    mef.output %ch13 : !mef.chain
  }
  // %ch14 -> expansion of %ch11
  // CHECK: %[[CH14:.*]] = grt.chain.create (%[[CH7]], %[[CH5]], %[[CH6]], %[[CH12]])
  %ch14 = grt.chain.create (%ch10, %ch11, %ch12)
  // CHECK: mef.output %[[CH14]]
  mef.output %ch14 : !mef.chain
}

// RUN: mo-opt %s --mgp-stage-device-graphs --allow-unregistered-dialect --split-input-file | FileCheck %s

// An `isDeviceGraph` model: every `mogg.routine.async` in the execute
// block is moved into a single `IsolatedFromAbove` `mgp.device_graph.staging`
// op. Free values the regions reference (here the model input) become operands
// passed in as bare-`T` block args; values consumed outside become the op's
// results (type `T`), yielded as bare `T`.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg
// CHECK: execute (%{{.*}}: !mef.chain{{.*}}%[[IN:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) ->
// The staging op takes the free value as an operand and exposes it to the body
// as a bare-`T` block arg alongside the device-graph builder.
// CHECK: %[[STAGING:.*]] = mgp.device_graph.staging inputs(%[[IN]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
// CHECK-NEXT: ^bb0(%{{.*}}: !mgp.device_graph.builder, %[[INT:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>):
// The bare input feeds region A directly; region B consumes A's result. No
// async pack/unpack is introduced at the staging boundary.
// CHECK-NOT: mogg.async.unpack
// CHECK: %[[A:.*]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[INT]])
// CHECK: %[[B:.*]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[A]])
// The escaping value is yielded directly as bare `T`.
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.staging.yield %[[B]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: } -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: mef.output %{{.*}}, %[[STAGING]] : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>

mgp.model @dg device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  %a = mogg.routine.async (%in) : (%arg: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>> {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %b = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %u : <2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %p = mogg.async.pack(%b) : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
    mogg.output %p : !mogg.async<!mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>>
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.a">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  %b = mogg.routine.async (%a) : (%arg: !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>> {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
    %s = mgp.tensor_spec.create : !mgp.tensor_spec<2x3xf32>
    %ch = mogg.chain.dummy()
    %t = mgp.tensor.create %ch, %u, %s : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %p = mogg.async.pack(%t) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    mogg.output %p : !mogg.async<!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.b">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  mef.output %ch0, %b : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// A non-`mogg.routine.async` op interleaved between two staged regions
// (here an `mgp.guard`) must be staged together with them. `mgp.guard` is
// lowered to an equivalent `mogg.routine.async` and then staged as
// other compiled regions.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_guard
// No `mgp.guard` op is stranded ahead of the staging op (that stranding is the
// cycle); the guard has been rewritten to a compiled region.
// CHECK: execute (
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.guard
// The staging op takes only the model input -- its `inputs` must not reference a
// value the staging op itself produces.
// CHECK: %[[STAGING:.*]] = mgp.device_graph.staging inputs(%[[IN:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
// CHECK-NEXT: ^bb0(%{{.*}}: !mgp.device_graph.builder, %[[INT:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>):
// Region A (the assert) produces the chain.
// CHECK: %[[A:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[INT]])
// CHECK: fusionInfo = #{{assert[0-9]*}}
// The guard becomes a forwarding compiled region: it takes region A's chain and
// the input, forwards the input through, and carries the "mgp.guard" label.
// CHECK: %[[G:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[A]], %[[INT]]) : (%{{.*}}: !mef.chain, %{{.*}}: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>> {
// CHECK: fusionInfo = #{{guard[0-9]*}}
// Region B consumes the guard region's forwarded result.
// CHECK: mogg.routine.async (%[[G]])
// CHECK: fusionInfo = #{{b[0-9]*}}
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.staging.yield

mgp.model @dg_guard device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  // Region A: produces a chain (mirrors the `mgp.assert` region that feeds a
  // guard in the real graph).
  %ca = mogg.routine.async (%in) : (%arg: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mef.chain {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %r = mogg.async.ready
    mogg.output %r : !mef.chain
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.assert">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  // Guard: gates the model input on region A's chain. Not a compiled region, so
  // the current pass leaves it behind and forms the cycle.
  %g = mgp.guard %ca, %in : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  // Region B: consumes the guarded value.
  %b = mogg.routine.async (%g) : (%arg: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>> {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %s = mgp.tensor_spec.create : !mgp.tensor_spec<2x3xf32>
    %ch = mogg.chain.dummy()
    %bf = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %u : <2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %t = mgp.tensor.create %ch, %bf, %s : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %p = mogg.async.pack(%t) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    mogg.output %p : !mogg.async<!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.b">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  mef.output %ch0, %b : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// A model WITHOUT `isDeviceGraph` is left untouched: no staging op is created
// and the compiled region stays directly in the execute block.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @not_dg
// CHECK: mogg.routine.async
// CHECK-NOT: mgp.device_graph.staging

mgp.model @not_dg : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %a = mogg.routine.async (%in) : (%arg: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>> {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %b = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %u : <2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %p = mogg.async.pack(%b) : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
    mogg.output %p : !mogg.async<!mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>>
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.a">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  mef.output %ch0, %a : !mef.chain, !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// A mut-marked input (the lowered form of !mo.buffer, e.g. a KV cache) crosses
// the staging boundary with its type spelled verbatim: staging operand, body
// block arg, yield, and result all carry the `mut` marker.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_mut_input
// CHECK: execute (%{{.*}}: !mef.chain{{.*}}%[[IN:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) ->
// CHECK: %[[STAGING:.*]] = mgp.device_graph.staging inputs(%[[IN]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) {
// CHECK-NEXT: ^bb0(%{{.*}}: !mgp.device_graph.builder, %[[INT:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>):
// CHECK: %[[A:.*]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[INT]])
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.staging.yield %[[A]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>
// CHECK: } -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>
// CHECK: mef.output %{{.*}}, %[[STAGING]] : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>

mgp.model @dg_mut_input device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) {
  %a = mogg.routine.async (%in) : (%arg: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut> {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>
    %p = mogg.async.pack(%u) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>
    mogg.output %p : !mogg.async<!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>>
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.a">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  mef.output %ch0, %a : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, mut>
}

// -----

// A host-placed tensor input (dispatch metadata) crosses the staging boundary
// with its cpu placement spelled verbatim, alongside the gpu data tensor.

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_host_input
// CHECK: execute (%{{.*}}: !mef.chain{{.*}}%[[IN:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %[[H:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<4xsi64>) ->
// CHECK: %[[STAGING:.*]] = mgp.device_graph.staging inputs(%[[IN]], %[[H]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor<4xsi64>) {
// CHECK-NEXT: ^bb0(%{{.*}}: !mgp.device_graph.builder, %[[INT:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %[[HT:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<4xsi64>):
// CHECK: %[[A:.*]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[INT]], %[[HT]])
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.staging.yield %[[A]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: } -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>

mgp.model @dg_host_input device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %h: !mgp.tensor<4xsi64, <"cpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
  %a = mogg.routine.async (%in, %h) : (%arg: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, %meta: !mgp.tensor<4xsi64, <"cpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>> {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %m = mogg.async.unpack(%meta) : !mgp.tensor<4xsi64, <"cpu", 0>>
    %p = mogg.async.pack(%u) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    mogg.output %p : !mogg.async<!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.a">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  mef.output %ch0, %a : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
}

// -----

// `mgp.device_graph.stable.create` ops that promote a staged producer result
// are pulled into the staging body rather than left outside (which would create
// a dataflow cycle with the staging op).

// CHECK-LABEL: mgp.model @dg_stable_create
// CHECK: execute (%{{.*}}: !mef.chain{{.*}}%[[IN:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) ->
// CHECK: %[[STAGING:.*]] = mgp.device_graph.staging inputs(%[[IN]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) {
// CHECK-NEXT: ^bb0(%{{.*}}: !mgp.device_graph.builder, %[[INT:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]]: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>):
// CHECK: %[[A:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[INT]])
// CHECK: %[[S:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mgp.device_graph.stable.create %[[A]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
// CHECK: %[[B:[a-zA-Z0-9_]+]] = mogg.routine.async (%[[S]])
// CHECK: mgp.device_graph.staging.yield %[[B]] : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>
// CHECK: } -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>

mgp.model @dg_stable_create device_graph : mof devices [#M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>]
  init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>) {
  %ch0 = grt.chain.create ()
  %ctx = mgp.context.create 1
  mef.output %ch0, %ctx, %weights, %gpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
} execute (%ch0: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %gpu: !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>, %in: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> (!mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>) {
  %a = mogg.routine.async (%in) : (%arg: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>> {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %p = mogg.async.pack(%u) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    mogg.output %p : !mogg.async<!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>>
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.producer">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  %s = mgp.device_graph.stable.create %a : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
  %b = mogg.routine.async (%s) : (%arg: !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>) -> !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable> {
    %u = mogg.async.unpack(%arg) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>
    %p = mogg.async.pack(%u) : !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>
    mogg.output %p : !mogg.async<!mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>>
  } fusionInfo = #mogg.fusion<#mogg.fusion_leaf<"test.consumer">> inOutSignature = <""> {device = #M.device_ref<"gpu", 0>}
  mef.output %ch0, %b : !mef.chain, !mgp.tensor<2x3xf32, <"gpu", 0>, stable>
}
GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MOGGDialect/Transforms/codegen-map-abi-stub.mlir · complete source
// RUN: rm -rf %t && mkdir -p %t
// RUN: env MODULAR_DEBUG=ir-output-dir=%t mo-opt %s \
// RUN:   --mogg-import-packages="mojo-pkg-paths=%kernel_api_test_lib" \
// RUN:   --mo-to-map --map-to-mogg --mogg-conform-call-operands \
// RUN:   --mogg-outline-routines --mogg-emit-mojo -verify-each=false
// RUN: FileCheck %s < %t/graph.mojo

// End-to-end Mojo emission for the MOGG-ABI `mogg.func`
// (FuncOp::emitMojoMOGGABI plus the shape.create / tensor.create /
// call.opaque / scalar.create / tuple.create emitters). The MOGG stub takes raw
// `!mogg.pointer` / `!mogg.dim` / `!mogg.context` handles and reconstructs the
// codegen tensors internally before invoking the opaque kernel's execute
// function.
//
// The pipeline is stopped right after emission: the surrounding `mogg.routine`
// container is only consumed later (MOGGToMGP + region outlining), so its
// `mogg.call` dangles once emit erases the stub -- `-verify-each=false`
// tolerates that. The emitted Mojo is read from the `ir-output-dir` dump rather
// than `--mogg-dump-mojo`, which needs a fully lowered `mgp.model`.

// Plain output: static shape -> compile-time `Idx[N]` Coord, a raw-pointer
// `mogg_tensor_init` per tensor, and a DPS execute call (output, input, ctx).
// CHECK: def {{__[A-Za-z0-9_]+}}({{.*}}: OpaquePointer[MutAnyOrigin], {{.*}}: OpaquePointer[MutAnyOrigin], [[PC:.*]]: {{.*}}DeviceContext) raises:
// CHECK:   var [[PSHAPE:.*]] = layout.Coord(layout.Idx[2], layout.Idx[2])
// CHECK:   var [[PLAYOUT:.*]] = layout.row_major([[PSHAPE]])
// CHECK:   var [[PIN:.*]] = {{.*}}mogg_tensor_init[DType.float32, 2, False, extensibility.IO.Input, {{[0-9]+}}]({{.*}}.unsafe_bitcast[NoneType](), [[PLAYOUT]])
// CHECK:   var [[POUT:.*]] = {{.*}}mogg_tensor_init[DType.float32, 2, True, extensibility.IO.Output, {{[0-9]+}}]({{.*}}.unsafe_bitcast[NoneType](), {{.*}})
// CHECK:   {{.*}}.MapLowerOnePlainOutput.execute[target = "cpu"]([[POUT]], [[PIN]], [[PC]])

mo.graph @plain(%a: !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32> {
  %c = mo.custom [symbol = "map_lower_one_plain_output", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%a) : (!mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
  mo.output %c : !mo.tensor<[2, 2], f32>
}

// Dynamic dim: the `!mogg.dim` handle arrives as a trailing `Int` argument and
// feeds a runtime `Scalar[DType.int]` Coord component.
// CHECK: def {{__[A-Za-z0-9_]+}}({{.*}}: OpaquePointer[MutAnyOrigin], {{.*}}: OpaquePointer[MutAnyOrigin], [[DIM:.*]]: Int, {{.*}}: {{.*}}DeviceContext) raises:
// CHECK:   var {{.*}} = layout.Coord(Scalar[DType.int]([[DIM]]), layout.Idx[4])

mo.graph @dyn(%a: !mo.tensor<[batch, 4], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[batch, 4], f32> {
  %c = mo.custom [symbol = "map_lower_one_plain_output", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%a) : (!mo.tensor<[batch, 4], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[batch, 4], f32>
  mo.output %c : !mo.tensor<[batch, 4], f32>
}

// Scalar operand: `scalar.create` packs the single-element tensor into a scalar
// via `mogg_as_scalar`, passed after the input in the DPS execute call.
// CHECK: def {{__[A-Za-z0-9_]+}}(
// CHECK:   var [[SC:.*]] = {{.*}}mogg_as_scalar({{.*}})
// CHECK:   {{.*}}.MapLowerScalar.execute[target = "cpu"]({{.*}}, {{.*}}, [[SC]], {{.*}})

mo.graph @scalar(%a: !mo.tensor<[4], f32>, %s: !mo.tensor<[], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[4], f32> {
  %c = mo.custom [symbol = "map_lower_scalar", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%a, %s) : (!mo.tensor<[4], f32>, !mo.tensor<[], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
  mo.output %c : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
}

// Variadic operands: `tuple.create` packs the run of tensors into a
// `VariadicTensors` (pointer + shape tuples plus a comptime static-spec list).
// CHECK: def {{__[A-Za-z0-9_]+}}(
// CHECK:   var {{.*}} = std.utils.StaticTuple[size = 2]({{.*}}._ptr, {{.*}}._ptr)
// CHECK:   var {{.*}} = std.utils.StaticTuple[size = 2]({{.*}}.shape(), {{.*}}.shape())
// CHECK:   var [[VT:.*]] = extensibility.VariadicTensors[{{.*}}static_specs = {{.*}}]({{.*}}, {{.*}})
// CHECK:   {{.*}}.MapLowerVariadic.execute[target = "cpu"]({{.*}}, [[VT]], {{.*}})

mo.graph @variadic(%a: !mo.tensor<[4], f32>, %b: !mo.tensor<[4], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[4], f32> {
  %c = mo.custom [symbol = "map_lower_variadic", device = #M.device_ref<"cpu", 0>](%a, %b) : (!mo.tensor<[4], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
  mo.output %c : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
}
GraphCompiler/test/mo-opt/MOGGDialect/Transforms/infra-add-try-except-blocks.mlir · complete source
// RUN: mo-opt %s --mogg-import-packages -mo-to-map --map-outline-structured-kernel-bodies --map-to-mogg --mogg-pipeline -mogg-to-mgp -canonicalize -mogg-outline-async-routines -mogg-add-try-except-blocks 2>&1 | FileCheck %s

// Verify that the three ops introduced by the MOGG ABI lowering are present
// after mogg-outline-async-routines and mogg-add-try-except-blocks:
//
//   mogg.with_trace  -- created by mogg-outline-async-routines (createKernelStub)
//                       to wrap the kernel terminator in a Trace context
//   mogg.try / mogg.raise -- created by mogg-add-try-except-blocks for MOGG
//                            ABI stubs; the except block re-raises via mogg.raise

// The MGP ABI stub (@region_0) wraps the call to the MOGG stub in a
// mogg.try/except that returns an async error value instead of raising.
// CHECK-LABEL: mogg.func @{{__[A-Za-z0-9_]+_async}} private
// CHECK:         mogg.try {
// CHECK-NOT:       mogg.raise
// CHECK:         } except(%{{[^)]+}}) {

// The MOGG ABI stub (@relu_mogg) has mogg.with_trace around the kernel
// terminator and mogg.try/mogg.raise for error propagation.
// CHECK-LABEL: mogg.func @__relu private
// CHECK:         mogg.try {
// CHECK:           mogg.with_trace
// CHECK:             mogg.call.foreach
// CHECK:           }
// CHECK:           mogg.yield
// CHECK:         } except(%{{[^)]+}}) {
// CHECK:           mogg.raise

mo.graph @relu(%x: !mo.tensor<[4], f32>) -> !mo.tensor<[4], f32> {
  %result = mo.relu(%x) : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
  mo.output %result : !mo.tensor<[4], f32>
}

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from max.driver import CPU, Accelerator, Buffer, accelerator_count
from max.dtype import DType
from max.engine.api import InferenceSession
from max.graph import DeviceRef, Graph, TensorType, ops


def main() -> None:
    mojo_kernels = Path(__file__).parent / "kernels"

    dtype = DType.float32

    # Place the graph on a GPU, if available. Fall back to CPU if not.
    device = CPU() if accelerator_count() == 0 else Accelerator()
    if accelerator_count() == 0:
        N = 8
        D = 8
        BD = 4
        BN = 4
    else:
        N = 32
        D = 32
        BD = 8
        BN = 16

    with Graph(
        "fused_attention",
        input_types=[
            TensorType(
                dtype, shape=[N, D], device=DeviceRef.from_device(device)
            ),
            TensorType(
                dtype, shape=[N, D], device=DeviceRef.from_device(device)
            ),
            TensorType(
                dtype, shape=[N, D], device=DeviceRef.from_device(device)
            ),
        ],
        custom_extensions=[mojo_kernels],
    ) as graph:
        q, k, v, *_ = graph.inputs
        results = ops.custom(
            name="modular_ops::fused_attention_custom",
            device=DeviceRef.from_device(device),
            parameters={"BD": BD, "BN": BN},
            values=[q, k, v],
            out_types=[
                TensorType(
                    dtype, shape=[N, D], device=DeviceRef.from_device(device)
                )
            ],
        )
        graph.output(*results)

    # Set up an inference session for running the graph.
    session = InferenceSession(devices=[device])

    # Compile the graph.
    compiled = session.compile(graph)
    model = session.init(compiled)

    np.random.seed(123)
    Q = Buffer.from_numpy(np.random.randn(N, D).astype("f")).to(device)
    K = Buffer.from_numpy(np.random.randn(N, D).astype("f")).to(device)
    V = Buffer.from_numpy(np.random.randn(N, D).astype("f")).to(device)

    output = model.execute(Q, K, V)
    print(output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
The code below computes the attention score for a tile of size BN x BD.
It follows the exact arithmetic as described in the FlashAttention-2 paper
(https://arxiv.org/pdf/2307.08691). The variable names in this program
reflect the variable names in the algorithms from the paper.

Here, the following tensors are Q for the query,
K for the key, V for the value, and O for the output.

       Q            K               V
  +----D----+  +----D----+   +--+--BD--+---+
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  +---------+  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |.........|  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  BN........|  N.........|   N  |......|   |
  |.........|  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  +---------+  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  |         |  |.........|   |  |......|   |
  +---------+  +---------+   +--+------+---+

The main trick is in the softmax computation.
As the paper says, S and P are intermediate values.

Let S = Q * K^T  ∈ R^{N, D}
    P = Softmax(S) ∈ R^{N, D}
The attention score is O = P * V ∈ R^{N, D}.

One way to think about this is to consider what happens if we
split the dimensions N in  K, and Q into two tiles: K_1 and K_2, V_1 and V_2.
Then we can incrementally compute the output as follows:
  S_1 = Q * K_1, S_2 = Q * K_2
  O_i = O_{i-1} * renormalization_factor + softmax(S_i) * V_i

This allows for the incremental computation of softmax(S_i) * V_i,
leading to the final output.
"""


from max.gpu.host import DeviceContext
from max.gpu import block_idx
from max.gpu.sync import barrier
from layout import TensorLayout, TileTensor, row_major, stack_allocation
from layout.math import max, sum
from layout.tensor_core import TensorCore

from extensibility import register, InputTensor, OutputTensor

from std.utils import Index


@register("modular_ops::fused_attention_custom")
struct FusedAttention:
    """Registers the `fused_attention_custom` op, allowing python to use it from the `max`
    package.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def execute[
        dtype: DType,
        rank: Int,
        //,  # Forces the previous two params to be inferred from the args
        BN: Int,  # Dimension of blocks to split Q into
        BD: Int,  # Dimension of blocks to split K, V into
        target: StaticString,  # "cpu" or "gpu"
    ](
        output: OutputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        query: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        key: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        value: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        ctx: DeviceContext,
    ) raises:
        comptime assert rank == 2, "rank must be 2"

        # Query tensor
        var Q = query.to_tile_tensor().as_unsafe_any_origin()
        # Key tensor
        var K = key.to_tile_tensor().as_unsafe_any_origin()
        # Value tensor
        var V = value.to_tile_tensor().as_unsafe_any_origin()
        # Attention output tensor
        var O = output.to_tile_tensor().as_unsafe_any_origin()

        comptime if target == "cpu":
            print("Running on CPU")
            fused_attention_cpu[BN, BD](Q, K, V, O)
        else:
            var dev_ctx = ctx
            print("Running on GPU")
            fused_attention_gpu[BN, BD](dev_ctx, Q, K, V, O)


# CustomOpLibrary does not support names with '::' in them currently. Create
# a simple alias so the whisper example works.
@register("fused_attention_custom")
struct FusedAttentionAlias:
    @staticmethod
    def execute[
        dtype: DType,
        rank: Int,
        //,  # Forces the previous two params to be inferred from the args
        BN: Int,  # Dimension of blocks to split Q into
        BD: Int,  # Dimension of blocks to split K, V into
        target: StaticString,  # "cpu" or "gpu"
    ](
        output: OutputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        query: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        key: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        value: InputTensor[dtype=dtype, rank=rank, ...],
        ctx: DeviceContext,
    ) raises:
        FusedAttention.execute[BN=BN, BD=BD, target=target](
            output, query, key, value, ctx
        )


@inline(.always)
def matmul_b_transpose(
    lhs: TileTensor,
    rhs: TileTensor,
    out res: TileTensor[
        lhs.dtype,
        type_of(row_major[lhs.static_shape[0], rhs.static_shape[0]]()),
        MutUntrackedOrigin,
    ],
):
    res = stack_allocation[lhs.dtype](
        row_major[lhs.static_shape[0], rhs.static_shape[0]]()
    )

    comptime for m in range(lhs.static_shape[0]):
        comptime for n in range(rhs.static_shape[0]):
            res[m, n] = 0.0

            comptime for k in range(lhs.static_shape[1]):
                res[m, n] += rebind[res.ElementType](
                    lhs[m, k].cast[res.dtype]()
                ) * rebind[res.ElementType](rhs[n, k].cast[res.dtype]())


# The bulk of the code below implements what the papers calls
# an "online softmax", which is local to each block.
# The algorithm is described as:
#
# $$$
# m_1 = rowmax(S_1)
# l_1 = rowsum(e^(S_1-m_1))
# P_1 = diag(l_1)^-1 * e^(S_1-m_1)
# O_1 = P_1*V_1 = diag(l_1)^-1 * e^(S_1-m_1) * V_1
# m_2 = max(m_1, rowmax(S_2)) = m
# l_2 = e^(m_1-m_2) * l_1 _ rowsum(e^(S_2-m_2))
#     = rowsum(e^(S_1-m)) + rowsum(e^(S_2-m)) = ls
# P_2 = diag(l_2)^-1 * e^(S_2-m_2)
# O_2 = diag(l_1/l_2)^-1 * O_1 + (P_2 * V_2)
#     = diag(l_2)^-1 * e^(S_2-m) * V
# $$$


@inline(.always)
def fused_attention_cpu[
    BN: Int, BD: Int
](Q: TileTensor, K: TileTensor, V: TileTensor, O: TileTensor[mut=True, ...],):
    comptime N = K.static_shape[0]
    comptime D = K.static_shape[1]

    comptime for tile_n in range(N // BN):
        var Q_tile = Q.tile[BN, D](tile_n, 0)

        comptime for tile_d in range(D // BD):
            var m_1 = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]()).fill(
                Scalar[Q.dtype].MIN
            )

            var l_1 = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]()).fill(0)

            var O_i = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN, BD]()).fill(0)

            comptime for tile_n_idx in range(N // BN):
                var K_tile = K.tile[BN, D](tile_n_idx, 0)
                var V_tile = V.tile[BN, BD](tile_n_idx, tile_d)

                var S = matmul_b_transpose(Q_tile, K_tile)
                var m_2 = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]())
                max[axis=1](S, m_2)
                m_2.max(m_1)

                # l_2 = exp(m_1 - m_2) * l_1 + sum(axis=1, exp(S - m_2))
                var l_2 = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]())
                l_2.copy_from(m_1)
                l_2 -= m_2
                l_2.exp()
                l_2 *= l_1
                var E = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN, BN]())
                E.copy_from(S)
                E -= m_2
                E.exp()
                var l_2_sum = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]())
                sum[axis=1](E, l_2_sum)
                l_2 += l_2_sum

                # P = exp(S - m_2) / l_2
                E /= l_2
                O_i *= l_1
                O_i /= l_2
                var m_1_delta = stack_allocation[Q.dtype](row_major[BN]())
                m_1_delta.copy_from(m_1)
                m_1_delta -= m_2
                m_1_delta.exp()
                O_i *= m_1_delta
                var PV = matmul["cpu"](E, V_tile)
                O_i += PV
                m_1.copy_from(m_2)
                l_1.copy_from(l_2)

            O.tile[BN, BD](tile_n, tile_d).copy_from(O_i)


@inline(.always)
def matmul[
    dtype: DType,
    rhs_dtype: DType,
    //,
    target: StaticString,
    transpose_b: Bool = False,
](
    lhs: TileTensor[dtype, ...],
    rhs: TileTensor[rhs_dtype, ...],
    out res: TileTensor[
        dtype,
        type_of(row_major[lhs.static_shape[0], rhs.static_shape[0]]()),
        MutUntrackedOrigin,
        address_space=lhs.address_space,
    ],
):
    res = stack_allocation[dtype, address_space=lhs.address_space](
        row_major[lhs.static_shape[0], rhs.static_shape[0]]()
    )

    comptime if target == "cpu":
        comptime for m in range(lhs.static_shape[0]):
            comptime for n in range(rhs.static_shape[1]):
                res[m, n] = 0.0

                comptime for k in range(lhs.static_shape[1]):
                    res[m, n] += rebind[res.ElementType](
                        lhs[m, k].cast[res.dtype]()
                    ) * rebind[res.ElementType](rhs[k, n].cast[res.dtype]())
    else:
        comptime M = lhs.static_shape[0]
        comptime N = rhs.static_shape[0]
        comptime K = lhs.static_shape[1]

        var out_sram = stack_allocation[res.dtype, address_space=.SHARED](
            row_major[M, N]()
        )

        comptime BK = 8

        comptime assert K % 8 == 0, "K needs to be a multiple of 8"

        var mma_b_t = TensorCore[dtype, dtype, Index(M, N, BK), transpose_b]()

        var c_reg = stack_allocation[dtype, address_space=.LOCAL](
            mma_b_t.c_fragment_layout
        ).fill(0)

        # `TensorCore`'s native loads require matching operand dtypes;
        # rebind the B view once when `rhs` carries a different dtype.
        var rhs_typed = rebind[
            TileTensor[
                dtype,
                rhs.LayoutType,
                rhs.origin,
                Engine=rhs.Engine,
                address_space=rhs.address_space,
                linear_idx_type=rhs.linear_idx_type,
            ]
        ](rhs)

        comptime for k_i in range(K // BK):
            var a_reg = mma_b_t.load_a(lhs.tile[M, BK](0, k_i))

            var b_reg = mma_b_t.load_b(rhs_typed.tile[BK, N](k_i, 0))

            comptime if transpose_b:
                b_reg = rebind[type_of(b_reg)](
                    mma_b_t.load_b(rhs_typed.tile[N, BK](0, k_i))
                )

            var d_reg = mma_b_t.mma_op(a_reg, b_reg, c_reg)
            c_reg.copy_from(d_reg)
        mma_b_t.store_d(out_sram, c_reg)

        barrier()
        res.copy_from(out_sram)


def fused_attention_kernel[
    q_dtype: DType,
    q_layout: TensorLayout,
    k_dtype: DType,
    k_layout: TensorLayout,
    v_dtype: DType,
    v_layout: TensorLayout,
    o_dtype: DType,
    o_layout: TensorLayout,
    BN: Int,
    BD: Int,
](
    Q: TileTensor[q_dtype, q_layout, MutAnyOrigin],
    K: TileTensor[k_dtype, k_layout, MutAnyOrigin],
    V: TileTensor[v_dtype, v_layout, MutAnyOrigin],
    O: TileTensor[o_dtype, o_layout, MutAnyOrigin],
):
    comptime N = Q.static_shape[0]
    comptime D = Q.static_shape[1]

    var Q_tile = Q.tile[BN, D](block_idx.y, 0)

    var m_1 = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]()).fill(
        Scalar[q_dtype].MIN
    )
    var l_1 = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]()).fill(0)
    var O_i = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN, BD]()).fill(0)

    comptime BN_1 = 8

    for tile_n_idx in range(N // BN_1):
        var K_tile = K.tile[BN_1, D](tile_n_idx, 0)
        var V_tile = V.tile[BN_1, BD](tile_n_idx, block_idx.x)
        var S = matmul["gpu", transpose_b=True](Q_tile, K_tile)
        var m_2 = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]())
        max[axis=1](S, m_2)
        m_2.max(m_1)

        # l_2 = exp(m_1 - m_2) * l_1 + sum(axis=1, exp(S - m_2))
        var l_2 = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]())
        l_2.copy_from(m_1)
        l_2 -= m_2
        l_2.exp()
        l_2 *= l_1
        var E = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN, BN_1]())
        E.copy_from(S)
        E -= m_2
        E.exp()
        var l_2_sum = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]())
        sum[axis=1](E, l_2_sum)
        l_2 += l_2_sum

        # P = exp(S - m_2) / l_2
        E /= l_2
        O_i *= l_1
        O_i /= l_2
        var m_1_delta = stack_allocation[q_dtype](row_major[BN]())
        m_1_delta.copy_from(m_1)
        m_1_delta -= m_2
        m_1_delta.exp()
        O_i *= m_1_delta
        var PV = matmul["gpu"](E, V_tile)
        O_i += PV
        m_1.copy_from(m_2)
        l_1.copy_from(l_2)
    O.tile[BN, BD](block_idx.y, block_idx.x).copy_from(O_i)


def fused_attention_gpu[
    BN: Int,
    BD: Int,
](
    ctx: DeviceContext,
    Q: TileTensor,
    K: TileTensor,
    V: TileTensor,
    O: TileTensor[mut=True, ...],
) raises:
    comptime kernel_func = fused_attention_kernel[
        Q.dtype,
        Q.LayoutType,
        K.dtype,
        K.LayoutType,
        V.dtype,
        V.LayoutType,
        O.dtype,
        O.LayoutType,
        BN,
        BD,
    ]
    ctx.enqueue_function[kernel_func](
        Q,
        K,
        V,
        O,
        grid_dim=(Int(Q.dim[1]()) // BD, Int(Q.dim[0]()) // BN),
        block_dim=(32),
    )
